tracks.title: It's Green, It's Got A Hood
tracks.mood: tipsy and dead serious about a coat
tracks.subject: describing your lost coat to the cloakroom attendant at four in the morning without your ticket
tracks.caption: Tech house in the current US club style. A dry punchy 909 kick on every beat, sidechained against a mono sub; a dry 909 clap on two and four; a rubbery filter-envelope synth bassline that bends up at the end of each bar and carries the hook; rolling off-beat open hi-hats with swung sixteenth shakers and rimshot ticks; one short minor chord stab every two bars; a snare roll and white-noise riser into a filtered breakdown before the last hook. Dry and tight, narrow low end with the kick and bass forward, hats wide, almost no reverb. Male voice, low and deadpan, half-spoken in the verses and repeating one short half-sung line as the hook, a single live singer with no effects. 126 BPM, G minor. Tipsy and dead serious about a coat. No big sung pop chorus, no trance supersaw, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no afro percussion.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short, 909 kick and rubbery bassline]

[Verse 1]
Four a.m. at the cloakroom and I've got no ticket
I had it in my hand, and then I had a mojito
The man behind the counter has a thousand coats
He says "describe it", so I lean in close

[Pre-Chorus]
I say listen, listen
It's not complicated

[Chorus]
It's green, it's got a hood
It's green, it's got a hood
Left pocket, half a Twix and a dry-cleaning tag
It's green, it's got a hood

[Verse 2]
He holds up something green, I say no, that's moss
He holds up something with a hood, I say that's beige
There's a queue behind me now and they're getting into it
A girl in silver shouts "is the hood fur, though?"

[Pre-Chorus]
The hood is not fur
The hood is the hood

[Chorus]
It's green, it's got a hood
It's green, it's got a hood
He's gone into the back with a torch for me
That's it, that's my coat, it's green, it's got a hood

[Outro - bassline alone, kick drops out]
Ticket was in the hood the whole time
Don't tell him

tracks.title: Move The Prius
tracks.mood: petty, loud and very pleased with itself
tracks.subject: a diss track aimed at the neighbour whose Prius blocks your driveway every Thursday
tracks.caption: West Coast ratchet rap in the Mustard style, the Los Angeles club sound. TR-808 claps doubled with finger snaps on two and four; a deep 808 sub holding long notes under the riff; a staccato two-note synth-bass riff that bounces under every bar; sparse straight hi-hats with no rolls; a short loop of synth brass stabs and piano under the hook. Dry and loud with a lot of empty space, the claps and the lead voice forward, nothing washed in reverb. Male rap voice, aggressive and conversational with a grin in it, a gang of men shouting 'hey!' as the answer on the hook lines. 100 BPM, F minor. Petty, loud and very pleased with itself. No trap hi-hat triplet rolls, no sliding trap 808s, no distorted rage synth lead, no sung R&B chorus, no autotune, no dreamy keys.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - claps, snaps and a two-note synth bass]

[Verse 1]
Thursday morning, seven-oh-two, and I'm late again
Silver Prius parked across my driveway like it pays the rent
Little sunshade on the dash with a cartoon cat
I left a note on the windshield, he drew a smiley on the back
Bumper sticker says "coexist", Ken, coexist with my gate
Now I'm backing out across the lawn through my own tomato bed

[Hook]
Move the Prius! (Hey!)
Move the Prius! (Hey!)
Number forty-one, I know you're home, Ken
Move the Prius! (Hey!) Tell the cat I said it

[Verse 2]
He opens up the door in a robe, holding a mug of tea
Says "oh, is that a driveway?" Ken, it's got a gate, a curb cut and me
Ten years on the same street and we never said a word
Now I made a whole song about you, and I know you heard
I called the city, lady asked me "is it blocking all of it?"
I said half, ma'am, but it's the half my car is parked behind

[Hook]
Move the Prius! (Hey!)
Move the Prius! (Hey!)
Ken is on the porch with his tea and he's nodding
Don't dance to it, Ken! (Hey!) It's about you!

[Outro - claps drop out, sub rings out]
Next Thursday, seven-oh-two
I'm parking on his lawn

tracks.title: Nine-Volt
tracks.mood: sleep-deprived rage, played completely straight
tracks.subject: a smoke alarm chirping for a new battery at three in the morning on a ceiling you cannot reach
tracks.caption: Atmospheric alt-metal with metalcore breakdowns. A soft felt-piano intro under a clean male voice; drop-tuned seven-string guitars in drop A playing palm-muted djent chugs locked to the kick; live acoustic drums with a triggered kick, moving between half-time breakdowns and double-kick runs; an 808 sub drop under each breakdown; a low choir pad behind the choruses. Close and dry in the piano sections, wide and roomy in the choruses, guitars and kick forward. Male voice, a clean high tenor that reaches into falsetto, switching to screamed harsh vocals in the second verse and the breakdown. 140 BPM with half-time breakdowns, C-sharp minor. Sleep-deprived rage, played completely straight. No pop-punk skate beat, no rap verse, no autotune, no standard-tuned indie guitars, no trap hi-hats.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - soft felt piano, one high electronic chirp every few bars]

[Verse 1 - clean, close]
Three-oh-eight and the hallway chirps again
One short note, then forty seconds of nothing
I stand in the dark in my socks and I wait for it
It waits for me. It's better at waiting.

[Pre-Chorus]
The ceiling's eleven feet
The ladder's at my brother's

[Chorus - full band, half-time]
Nine-volt, nine-volt
You want a battery, I want my life back
I'm on a kitchen chair on top of the dining table
And I still can't reach you

[Verse 2 - screamed]
I took a broom to it at four
Now it's not chirping, it's screaming
Every light on the street comes on
Mrs Patel's at her gate in a dressing gown

[Chorus - full band, half-time]
Nine-volt, nine-volt
You want a battery, I want my life back
Two firemen in my hallway at half past four
And the tall one just reaches up

[Bridge - half-time breakdown, 808 drop, screamed]
He didn't even stand on his toes
He didn't even stand on his toes

[Outro - piano alone, no chirp]
Five-oh-two. It's quiet.
Now I can't sleep without it.

tracks.title: Fourth Floor Walk-Up
tracks.mood: earnest, out of breath, falling hard
tracks.subject: carrying a friend's sofa up four flights of a walk-up and realising on the third landing that you are in love with her
tracks.caption: Arena piano pop-rock power ballad. Solo grand piano under a close-miked raspy male vocal for the first verse; floor-tom pulses entering at the pre-chorus; a big reverb-heavy snare on two and four from the first chorus; distorted power-chord guitars and a string section arriving at the bridge, with stacked gang vocals and a lift up a whole step for the last chorus. Starts dry and intimate and builds wide and roomy, the voice always forward. Male voice, a raspy tenor, intimate and nearly spoken in the verses, belting with falsetto cracks at the climax. 74 BPM, D major. Earnest, out of breath, falling hard. No trap drums, no EDM drop, no autotune, no country twang, no gospel organ.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - solo grand piano]

[Verse 1]
You said it's just a couch, it'll take ten minutes
It's a green velvet sleeper and it weighs about a ton
Fourth floor walk-up on Delancey, no elevator
You took the top end, so I've got all the weight

[Pre-Chorus - floor toms enter]
Second landing, it gets stuck on the rail
You start laughing and you can't stop

[Chorus - full drums]
I fell for you on the third floor landing
Holding half a sofa with my knees and my chin
You laughed so hard you had to sit down on it
And I didn't want it to fit

[Verse 2]
We took the legs off with a butter knife
Tipped it on its end and it slid around the turn
Mr. Ocampo from 3B held the door with his slipper
Said "you two been married long?" And neither of us said no

[Bridge - strings and power chords build]
Ten years I've known you, I've moved you four times
First time I ever wished there were more stairs to climb

[Chorus - lifted a whole step, gang vocals]
I fell for you on the third floor landing
Holding half a sofa with my knees and my chin
The legs are still in my jacket pocket
So I'll have to come back and screw them in

[Outro - solo piano]
Four floors down and still out of breath
You said bring the legs back Saturday

tracks.title: Gary's Actually Great
tracks.mood: furious that he's nice
tracks.subject: your ex's new boyfriend turning out to be genuinely nice at a friend's barbecue
tracks.caption: Pop-punk revival in the glossy 2000s style. Overdriven humbucker guitars playing palm-muted power chords in the verses and open chords in the chorus, with an octave lead line on top; a driving bass in straight eighths; drums on a straight rock beat in the verses and the skate beat in the choruses, kick on every beat and snare on every off-beat, with crash-heavy hits. Tight, compressed and bright, guitars wide and the voice forward. Male voice, a nasal bright tenor with a sneer, gang 'whoa-oh' backing vocals in the choruses. 172 BPM, E major. Furious that he's nice. No metal breakdowns, no screamed vocals, no synths, no autotune, no tapped emo guitars.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - palm-muted guitars, four-count on the snare]

[Verse 1]
Jess's barbecue, I brought a bag of ice like armor
She said "heads up, Megan's coming with the new guy"
I had a plan, I'd be funny, I'd be taller somehow
Then he walked in with a homemade pasta salad

[Pre-Chorus]
He remembered my name
He asked about my mom's knee

[Chorus]
Gary's actually great (whoa-oh)
And I hate it, I hate it, I hate it
He fixed the grill and he gave me the last burger
Gary's actually great (whoa-oh)

[Verse 2]
He's a paramedic and he hosts a podcast about trains
He laughed at my joke and it wasn't even a good one
Megan looks happy, like really, really happy
And Gary's teaching Jess's kid to throw a frisbee

[Pre-Chorus]
He doesn't even drink
He drove three people home

[Chorus]
Gary's actually great (whoa-oh)
And I hate it, I hate it, I hate it
He asked if I want to join his bowling team on Thursdays
And I said yes, Gary's actually great

[Outro - skate beat, then a hard stop]
Thursday, lane nine
I bought my own shoes
[Song ends abruptly]

tracks.title: Miss Gloria's Extension Cord
tracks.mood: rowdy, bossy and laughing
tracks.subject: a block party whose DJ keeps losing power because the extension cord runs through Miss Gloria's kitchen
tracks.caption: New Orleans bounce on the Triggerman beat. Booming 808 kicks; rapid TR-808 handclap rolls; the Triggerman bell riff looping every bar; a short stabbed synth bass on the one; a crowd of shouting voices answering the lead lines. Heavy and dry, the low end huge and forward, almost no harmony, the arrangement repeating hard. Female voice, a commanding block-party MC, shouting and chanting with high energy in call-and-response with the crowd. 102 BPM, G minor. Rowdy, bossy and laughing. No trap hi-hat rolls, no sung pop chorus, no Baltimore club breakbeat, no autotune, no smooth R&B.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Triggerman bell riff and 808 clap roll]

[Verse 1]
St. Claude and Music, Saturday, tables in the street
DJ Trey got the speakers stacked up six high
All the power coming down one orange cord
Through Miss Gloria's window, past her stove, to the plug by her fridge

[Hook]
Who got the power? (Miss Gloria!)
Who got the power? (Miss Gloria!)
She's cooking gumbo and she needs that outlet
Who got the power? (Miss Gloria!)

[Verse 2]
Every time she plugs the rice cooker in, the whole block goes dark
Thirty people freeze in the middle of a bounce
DJ Trey on his knees at her screen door, begging
She say "baby, you can have it when the rice is done"

[Bridge - claps only, crowd answers]
Rice is done! (Rice is done!)
Now take it to the ground! (To the ground!)

[Hook]
Who got the power? (Miss Gloria!)
Who got the power? (Miss Gloria!)
She's on the porch with a ladle and a cash box
First bowl five, and the plug's included! (Miss Gloria!)

[Outro - bell riff, kick drops out]
Second bowl, two dollars
And the plug stay hers

tracks.title: Lionel Says Don't Look Down
tracks.mood: clumsy, sweaty and delighted
tracks.subject: being taught the zydeco two-step at a Sunday afternoon dance in Opelousas by a seventy-three-year-old retired mailman
tracks.caption: Zydeco in the Louisiana Creole dance-hall style. A piano accordion playing bright bluesy lead riffs and answering the singer; a frottoir rubboard scraped with spoons in steady sixteenths; a syncopated electric bass line; a drum kit playing the two-step shuffle with the double-clutch kick; a choppy blues rhythm electric guitar. Live and roomy like a packed dance hall, the accordion and rubboard forward and the bass warm underneath. Male voice, a bluesy and soulful baritone, with dance-hall call-outs sung back by the band. 132 BPM, G major. Clumsy, sweaty and delighted. No banjo, no fiddle, no country twang, no autotune, no rock drums, no synths.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - accordion riff and rubboard]

[Verse 1]
Sunday at the Y-Ki-Ki, four o'clock in Opelousas
I came for the boudin, I did not come to dance
Then a man in a pressed white shirt held his hand out
Seventy-three, retired mailman, name of Lionel

[Chorus]
Lionel says don't look down (don't look down!)
Your feet know more than you do
Slow, then quick-quick, let the rubboard count it
Lionel says don't look down

[Instrumental Break - accordion solo over rubboard]

[Verse 2]
I stepped on him twice in the two-step, three times in the waltz
He said "I walked a mail route forty years, these feet have seen worse"
The accordion man is grinning, he slows it down for me
Half the floor is watching, half the floor is worse than me

[Chorus]
Lionel says don't look down (don't look down!)
Your feet know more than you do
I'm looking at the ceiling fan and I haven't missed a step
Lionel says now you're dancing (now you're dancing!)

[Outro - accordion and rubboard trade fours]
Same time next Sunday
Bring cracklins for Lionel

tracks.title: Lake Effect
tracks.mood: proud, cold and unbothered
tracks.subject: an overnight snowplough driver in Buffalo during a lake-effect storm who raps about his truck like it is a luxury car
tracks.caption: Buffalo grimy boom bap in the Griselda style. A dusty low-passed loop of old Italian film-score strings and harpsichord, instrumental only, with vinyl crackle and SP-1200 grit; a muffled kick and a dull snare with no hi-hats; a deep upright-bass note doubled under each turn of the loop. Dark, dry and mono-leaning, the loop and the voice forward and everything else buried. Male rap voice, gritty, deadpan and dense, long bars delivered flat and certain, with short gruff ad-libs between lines. 86 BPM, E minor. Proud, cold and unbothered. No trap drums, no 808s, no hi-hat rolls, no sung chorus, no choir or soprano in the loop, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - film-score loop with vinyl crackle, no drums]

[Verse 1]
Eleven p.m., Cheektowaga yard, the International warming up, orange lights spinning on the roof
Ten tons, heated seat, heated mirrors, thermos of Tim Hortons, warmest man in Erie County (salt)
Seven feet of lake effect, Thruway shut since Tuesday, I'm the only thing on the map that's moving
Whole city tucked in under blankets, I lay rock salt down like marble in a hotel lobby (salt)

[Hook]
Lake effect, lake effect
Y'all stuck at home and I'm the one with the keys
Lake effect, lake effect
Delaware Avenue, four in the morning, all of it belong to me

[Verse 2]
Darlene on the radio, been calling routes since the Blizzard of '77
Says "Route 14, stuck Camry, a lady and a baby", say less, I'm there in six
Hooked the chain, pulled her out, she's pushing a twenty through the window at me
Told her keep it, buy milk, the bars come free with the plow (salt)

[Hook]
Lake effect, lake effect
Y'all stuck at home and I'm the one with the keys
Lake effect, lake effect
Sun come up on Delaware and I'm the reason you can leave

[Outro - loop alone, needle runs out]
Six a.m., keys to Marcus
I sleep through the part on the news where they thank the plows

tracks.title: Masih Login
tracks.mood: furious, spiteful, built for a crowd to shout back
tracks.subject: an ex who still logs into his streaming account three months after the breakup
tracks.caption: Indonesian emo and post-hardcore in the 2020s heartbreak-band style. A clean arpeggiated electric guitar intro with chorus and dotted-eighth delay; two drop-D distorted electric guitars playing palm-muted eighth-note chugs in the verses that open into ringing open chords and tremolo-picked leads on the chorus; a picked electric bass locked to the kick on root eighths; tight, punchy drums with a double-time punk beat in the pre-chorus and a half-time breakdown with crash-heavy hits and short double-kick bursts. Loud and wide, guitars doubled hard left and right, the lead vocal forward and dry enough that the strain is audible. Male high tenor, clean in the verses, pushing into a strained, cracking belt on the chorus, with a male gang-shout choir answering in the bridge. 164 BPM, D minor. Furious and spiteful, built for a crowd to shout back. No pop-punk bounce, no synths, no autotune, no rap verse, no trap drums.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - clean delay guitar arpeggio, then the full band crashes in]

[Verse 1]
Udah tiga bulan kita putus
Kamu yang bilang, aku yang pergi
Tapi tiap malam HP-ku bunyi
"Akunmu sedang dipakai di perangkat lain"

[Pre-Chorus - double-time drums]
Jam dua pagi kamu nonton drama
Pakai akunku, pakai gajiku

[Chorus]
Kamu masih login
Masih nonton pakai akun yang aku bayar tiap bulan
Kamu nggak mau aku
Tapi kamu masih mau semua yang aku punya

[Verse 2]
"Lanjutkan menonton" penuh film yang dulu kamu bilang ngebosenin
Ada profil baru, namanya "Sayang"
Dan itu jelas bukan buat aku
Jempolku udah di tombol "keluar dari semua perangkat"

[Bridge - half-time breakdown, gang shouts answer each line]
Ganti kata sandi! (Ganti!)
Hapus profilnya! (Hapus!)
Tiga bulan aku diam aja
Malam ini aku yang pencet

[Chorus]
Kamu masih login?
Masih nonton pakai akun yang aku bayar tiap bulan?
Kamu nggak mau aku
Ya udah, sekarang kamu nggak dapat apa-apa

[Outro - feedback ring, one last open chord]
Selamat nonton di tempat lain

tracks.title: Oleng
tracks.mood: flirty and teasing, a settled couple showing off for each other
tracks.subject: a couple on a rented tandem bike at Jakarta's Sunday car-free day on Sudirman, she pedalling hard from the back, he steering badly from the front, stopping for ketoprak by the roundabout
tracks.caption: Indonesian pop R&B with a soul-pop lean. Rhodes electric piano voicing ninth and thirteenth chords with a soft tremolo, a muted single-note funk guitar answering the vocal in short licks, warm finger bass sliding into the downbeats, and laid-back drums with swung sixteenth hi-hats, a late rimshot and finger snaps on two and four, plus stacked background harmonies on the chorus. Warm, close and dry, the Rhodes and lead vocal forward, the low end soft and round. Smooth male lead moving between chest voice and falsetto, with short R&B runs at the ends of phrases and a few spoken asides. 86 BPM, E-flat major. Flirty and teasing, an easy Sunday-morning love song for a settled couple. No trap hi-hats, no rap verse, no autotune, no EDM drop, no acoustic guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes chords and finger snaps]

[Verse 1]
Minggu pagi, jam enam, Sudirman tanpa mobil
Sewa sepeda tandem, tiga puluh ribu sejam
Kamu bilang, "Kamu yang setir, aku yang kuat"
Baru lima meter, kita hampir nabrak ondel-ondel

[Pre-Chorus]
Setangnya goyang, kamu ketawa di belakang
"Sayang, kiri dong! Kiri! Itu kiri yang lain!"

[Chorus]
Kamu yang gowes, aku yang oleng
Kakimu yang kerja, aku cuma pegang setang
Satu sepeda, dua orang, beda maunya
Tapi kalau jatuh, kita jatuhnya bareng

[Verse 2]
Bundaran HI, air mancurnya nyala
Kita minggir ke gerobak ketoprak biru
Kamu pesan cabe lima, aku cabe satu aja
Bumbu kacang nempel di dagumu, aku lap pakai jempol

[Chorus]
Kamu yang gowes, aku yang oleng
Kakimu yang kerja, aku cuma pegang setang
Satu sepeda, dua orang, beda maunya
Lima tahun kita begini, belum pernah jatuh juga

[Outro - Rhodes and falsetto ad-libs]
Jam sebelas, mobil udah mulai lewat lagi
Kiri, Sayang. Bukan, kiri yang lain.

tracks.title: Coret Aja
tracks.mood: giddy, rowdy and proud, a lump in the throat underneath
tracks.subject: the last day of SMA, when the whole class scribbles signatures and jokes on each other's white uniforms with markers and the homeroom teacher pretends to disapprove, then signs a sleeve himself
tracks.caption: Indonesian idol pop in the 48-group style. A fast-strummed clean electric guitar driving eighth notes, a bright saw-synth lead doubled by brass stabs on the hook, an octave-bouncing picked bass, driving four-on-the-floor drums with big snare-roll fills into each chorus, string-section swells, and a half-step key change into the final chorus. Bright, wide and loud, the unison vocals forward, with gaps left after the chant lines. Young female group: solo lines passed between members in the verses, bright head-voice unison on the chorus, and a shouted crowd chant answering in the bridge. 156 BPM, A major. Giddy, rowdy and proud, a whole class marking the last day of school. No trap drums, no rap verse, no autotune, no EDM drop, no K-pop dance break, no mellow city-pop groove, no ballad tempo.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - strummed guitar and synth brass hit, crowd count-in]

[Verse 1 - Solo]
Bel terakhir bunyi di kelas dua belas tiga
Tutup spidol berserakan di bawah meja
Kemeja putih tiga tahun, kerahnya udah kuning
Hari ini biarin kotor, hari ini harus penuh

[Pre-Chorus - Solo]
Dito nulis "utang gorengan goceng" di punggungku
Aku gambar kumis di atas saku bajunya

[Chorus - Group]
Coret aja! Punggung, lengan, kerah juga
Coret aja! Nama, nomor HP, sama ejekan
Spidol permanen, dicuci nggak bakal hilang
Biar Mama ngomel di rumah, ini bukti kita lulus

[Verse 2 - Solo]
Pak Hendra masuk, kacamatanya turun ke hidung
"Siapa yang ngajarin kalian kayak gini?"
Semua diam, spidol disembunyiin di belakang
Dia julurkan tangan, "Mana? Yang hitam, dong"

[Bridge - crowd chant answers each line]
Pak Hendra! (Tanda tangan!)
Lengan kiri! (Kiri!)
Yang gede, Pak! (Gede!)
Jangan cuma paraf! (Lengkap!)

[Chorus - Group, key change]
Coret aja! Punggung, lengan, kerah juga
Coret aja! Tanda tangan Pak Hendra paling gede
Spidol permanen, dicuci nggak bakal hilang
Biar Mama ngomel di rumah, wali kelas juga ikutan

[Outro - brass stabs and a final snare roll]
Ma, kemeja ini jangan dicuci, ya!

tracks.title: Helm Pink
tracks.mood: wounded and pleading, with a sting at the end
tracks.subject: seeing his girlfriend at a red light on the back of another man's motorbike, wearing the pink helmet he bought her
tracks.caption: Pop Melayu band in the late-2000s Indonesian style. A clean-to-crunch electric lead guitar playing Melayu-ornamented fills with grace-note turns and slides between vocal lines, acoustic guitar strumming steady eighths underneath, a keyboard string pad, a bamboo suling answering the chorus, a plain rock bass, and a simple four-four pop-rock kit with tom fills. Late-2000s radio band sound in a medium room, the lead guitar and voice forward, the suling slightly back. Male nasal high tenor with Melayu cengkok: ornamented turns and vibrato on held vowel endings, plaintive and pleading. 84 BPM, A minor. Wounded and pleading, with a sting at the end. No dangdut koplo kendang, no EDM, no autotune, no rap, no trap drums.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - suling melody over acoustic strum, lead guitar turn]

[Verse 1]
Lampu merah perempatan dekat pasar
Motor hitam berhenti tepat di sebelahku
Yang dibonceng pakai helm warna pink
Helm yang aku beli waktu kamu ulang tahun

[Pre-Chorus]
Kamu bilang malam ini di rumah aja
Kamu bilang kepalamu pusing

[Chorus]
Helm pink itu dari aku
Masih ada stiker namamu di belakangnya
Kamu peluk dia erat-erat
Kayak dulu kamu peluk aku

[Verse 2]
Lampu hijau, kalian jalan duluan
Aku diam, klakson di belakang ramai
HP-ku bunyi, pesan dari kamu
"Sayang, aku udah mau tidur, ya"

[Chorus]
Helm pink itu dari aku
Masih ada stiker namamu di belakangnya
Kamu bohong sambil dibonceng dia
Dan aku yang bayar helmnya

[Outro - lead guitar Melayu turn, suling fades]
Besok helmnya balikin, ya
Dia bisa beli sendiri

tracks.title: Imam Dadakan
tracks.mood: nervous, humbled, quietly funny
tracks.subject: being pushed forward to lead the Maghrib prayer in the office prayer room during overtime because the usual imam is on leave
tracks.caption: Contemporary Indonesian Islamic pop, pop religi style. A nylon-string guitar picking a gentle arpeggio, a string ensemble that swells under the chorus, rebana frame drums and a soft darbuka in place of a drum kit, short oud fills with maqam-flavoured ornaments between lines, and a soft mixed choir pad on the refrain. Warm and roomy, the nylon guitar and lead voice close and forward, the strings wide behind them. Clean, sincere male pop lead with gentle melisma on held notes, and a layered male and female choir singing the Arabic refrain. 90 BPM, D minor. Nervous, humbled and quietly funny. No trap beat, no EDM, no autotune, no rock drums, no spoken sermon.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - nylon guitar arpeggio and an oud phrase]

[Verse 1]
Musala lantai empat, azan Magrib baru selesai
Pak Darto cuti, pulang kampung ke Kebumen
Semua mundur pelan-pelan, pura-pura benerin lengan baju
Terus ada yang dorong punggungku ke depan

[Pre-Chorus]
Sajadahnya bau pewangi ruangan
Tanganku dingin kayak baru keluar dari kulkas

[Chorus - choir joins on the first line]
Rabbi yassir wa la tu'assir
Ya Allah, aku cuma hafal surat yang pendek
Di belakangku ada bos, ada OB, ada anak magang
Tolong jangan biarkan suaraku hilang

[Verse 2]
Allahu akbar, suaraku keluar kecil banget
Kalah sama AC yang netes di pojok
Habis Al-Fatihah, "aamiin" datang dari belakang
Pelan, bareng-bareng, kayak tangan yang nahan punggungku

[Chorus - full strings, choir on the first line]
Rabbi yassir wa la tu'assir
Ya Allah, ternyata yang pendek pun cukup
Di belakangku ada bos, ada OB, ada anak magang
Dahi kami di karpet yang sama

[Outro - choir hums the refrain, rebana fades]
Salam ke kanan, salam ke kiri
Ada yang nepuk bahuku, "Besok kamu lagi, ya"

tracks.title: Titip Kunci
tracks.mood: dignified release that builds to defiance
tracks.subject: leaving the spare key to his apartment with the night security guard instead of returning it face to face
tracks.caption: Indonesian orchestral diva ballad in the film-soundtrack power-ballad style. A grand piano intro with sustain-pedal arpeggios, a full string section with a cello countermelody in the second verse and violin swells into each chorus, a soft synth pad underneath, drums entering only at the second chorus with a big reverb-heavy snare and tom fills, and a timpani and cymbal swell setting up a whole-step key change for the final chorus. Cinematic and wide: the piano and voice close and intimate in the first verse, the strings and drums filling the room by the end. Solo female belter, breathy and close in the verses, building to chest-mix belts with melismatic runs at phrase ends and high ad-libs over the last chorus. 70 BPM, B-flat major. Dignified release that builds to defiance. No EDM drop, no trap drums, no autotune, no rap, no rock guitar solo.

tracks.title: Mangga Tetangga
tracks.mood: santuy, a whole afternoon spent waiting for one mango
tracks.subject: waiting all afternoon under the neighbour's overhanging mango tree because, by kampung custom, fruit that falls on your side is yours
tracks.caption: Indonesian roots reggae. One-drop drums with the kick and cross-stick landing together on beat three and dub delay throws on the snare, an offbeat electric guitar skank with tight muted chops, a Hammond organ bubble shuffling between the skanks, a deep, round melodic bass riff carrying the hook, short horn-section riffs answering the chorus, and a spring-reverb and tape-echo dub drop in the breakdown. Warm and roomy, the bass loud and round in the middle of the mix, the voice relaxed and slightly behind the beat. Relaxed male baritone singing laid-back melodies, with a singjay toasting passage in the second verse. 76 BPM, G major. Santuy: a whole afternoon spent waiting for one mango, and nobody in a hurry. No trap drums, no EDM, no autotune, no dangdut or dansa party beat, no rock guitar solo.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - one-drop drums, bass riff, organ bubble]

[Verse 1]
Pohon mangga tetangga condong ke halamanku
Buahnya satu, gede, kuning, tinggal nunggu jatuh
Kata orang tua, yang jatuh di sini punyaku
Jadi aku duduk di bawahnya dari jam dua

[Chorus - horns answer]
Santuy, santuy, tunggu aja
Mangganya nggak bakal ke mana-mana
Angin juga nanti lewat sendiri
Aku di sini, kursi plastik, kopi item

[Verse 2 - singjay toasting]
Bu Yati di balik pagar ikut bawa kursi
Katanya batangnya di tanahnya, jadi itu punya dia
Aku bilang daunnya nyampah di halamanku tiap pagi
Anak-anak gang taruhan, ayam-ayam ikut nonton
Matahari turun, mangganya tetap diam

[Chorus - horns answer]
Santuy, santuy, tunggu aja
Mangganya nggak bakal ke mana-mana
Angin juga nanti lewat sendiri
Bu Yati bawa sambal, aku bawa pisau

[Bridge - dub break, echoes on the snare]
Selow, selow
Bluk!

[Outro - horn riff, then bass alone]
Jatuhnya pas di atas pagar
Ya udah, kita bikin rujak berdua

tracks.title: Foto KTP
tracks.mood: playful outrage
tracks.subject: begging the clerk at the subdistrict office to retake an ID card photo snapped mid-sneeze
tracks.caption: Retro swing jazz-pop in the style of 1950s Indonesian radio bands. Upright bass walking quarter notes, brushes on the snare with a swung ride cymbal, piano comping with a stride left hand, a muted trumpet obbligato answering the vocal, and a clarinet doubling the melody on the last chorus. Dry room sound with a small band playing close together; the first bars are band-limited like an old radio before the full band opens up. Crisp, playful female lead with witty, slightly old-fashioned phrasing, and close-harmony female backing singing the answers on the chorus. 168 BPM, F major. Playful outrage. No modern pop drums, no synths, no autotune, no bossa nova groove, no rock guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - radio-filtered piano and brushes, then the full band]

[Verse 1]
Kantor kecamatan, nomor antrean seratus tiga
Aku datang pakai bedak dan lipstik paling merah
Pak petugas bilang, "Lihat ke kamera, Bu"
Lalu dia jepret pas aku sedang bersin

[Chorus - backing answers]
Foto KTP, oh, foto KTP (Foto KTP!)
Mataku terpejam, mulutku entah ke mana
Seumur hidup aku bawa muka ini
Tolong, Pak, sekali lagi saja (Sekali lagi!)

[Verse 2]
Katanya sistemnya sudah terkunci
Aku bilang biasanya wajahku lebih rapi
Dia keluarkan dompet, tunjukkan KTP-nya sendiri
Rupanya dia difoto waktu menguap

[Instrumental Break - muted trumpet solo over walking bass]

[Chorus - backing answers, clarinet doubles]
Foto KTP, oh, foto KTP (Foto KTP!)
Matanya setengah terpejam, mataku juga
Seumur hidup kami bawa muka begini
Ya sudah, Pak, cetak saja (Cetak saja!)

[Outro - stride piano tag]
Kalau ada yang tanya, itu bukan aku
Itu aku, hari Selasa, waktu bersin

tracks.title: Prit, Dua Ribu
tracks.mood: deadpan fury you can dance to
tracks.subject: the parking attendant who appears from nowhere to whistle you out of a minimarket lot and charge two thousand rupiah
tracks.caption: Indonesian electro post-punk in the Central Java DIY protest style. A drum machine playing a straight motorik eighth-note kick and snare with a dry clap, a distorted and chorused bass riff as the main hook, an angular, trebly clean electric guitar repeating a two-note figure, and a cheap analog synth riff doubling the bass in the chorus. Raw and dry, mid-forward, with the bass and the shouted voice on top and almost no reverb. Shouted, deadpan female lead vocal chanting slogan lines, with a mixed crowd shouting the answers. 142 BPM, E minor. Deadpan fury you can dance to. No trap drums, no EDM drop, no autotune, no melodic pop chorus, no funkot kicks, no acoustic guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - drum machine and bass riff]

[Verse 1]
Aku masuk minimarket, nggak ada siapa-siapa
Beli air mineral, tiga ribu lima ratus
Aku keluar, motor baru mau mundur
Dari balik tiang listrik ada peluit bunyi

[Chorus - crowd answers]
Prit! (Dua ribu!)
Datang nggak kelihatan, pulang minta duit
Prit! (Dua ribu!)
Motorku nggak dijaga, cuma ditiupin

[Verse 2]
Dia nggak bantu nyeberang, dia nggak bantu mundur
Dia main HP di balik tiang listrik dari tadi
Tulisan di pintu "Parkir gratis" warnanya biru
Peluitnya lebih keras dari tulisannya

[Chorus - crowd answers]
Prit! (Dua ribu!)
Datang nggak kelihatan, pulang minta duit
Prit! (Dua ribu!)
Airku tiga ribu lima, parkirnya dua ribu

[Bridge - drum machine and voice only]
Aku kasih koin, dia nggak bilang makasih
Besok aku jalan kaki
Besok dia tetap di situ

[Outro - bass riff alone]
Prit.

[Song ends abruptly]

tracks.title: Sandal Jepit
tracks.mood: tender and warmly amused, ten years into a marriage
tracks.subject: a husband giving his wife his own flip-flops when her strap snaps on the walk home from the night fair, and walking the last kilometre barefoot
tracks.caption: Indonesian langgam keroncong in the 1950s Solo style, a song-form keroncong with a sung refrain. Cak and cuk interlocking in the crong-crong offbeat strum pattern, a cello plucked with the thumb in kendang-like ciblon rhythms, a pizzicato contrabass on the downbeats, a nylon-string guitar running arpeggios, a flute obbligato weaving around the voice, and a violin countermelody between phrases. Acoustic and roomy, the ensemble in a small hall, the voice centered with the flute just behind it. Smooth, legato male voice with a slow, wide vibrato and keroncong cengkok on held notes, unhurried. 72 BPM, C major. Tender and warmly amused, ten years into a marriage. No drum kit, no bossa nova guitar, no synths, no autotune, no pop ballad chorus.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - flute over the cak and cuk strum]

[Verse 1]
Pulang dari pasar malam Sekaten
Arum manis di tanganmu tinggal separuh
Di depan gapura tali sandalmu putus
Engkau tertawa, lalu berjalan pincang

[Chorus]
Pakailah sandalku, wahai kasih
Biar kakiku saja yang menyentuh aspal
Sepuluh tahun aku berjalan di sampingmu
Satu kilometer lagi tidak mengapa

[Verse 2]
Sandalku kebesaran di kakimu
Berbunyi plak-plak sepanjang jalan kampung
Tetangga di teras melihat dan berbisik
Engkau gandeng tanganku lebih erat

[Instrumental Break - violin and flute over cak and cuk]

[Chorus]
Pakailah sandalku, wahai kasih
Biar kakiku saja yang menyentuh aspal
Sepuluh tahun aku berjalan di sampingmu
Kerikil pun terasa seperti pasir

[Outro - flute and slow cello]
Sampai di pintu, engkau basuh kakiku
Besok kita beli sandal kembar

tracks.title: 半額シールの王
tracks.mood: cocky and ridiculous
tracks.subject: waiting at the supermarket deli counter at closing time for the half-price stickers to go on
tracks.caption: Japanese boom-bap storytelling rap. A dusty swung drum break with a fat round kick and a cracking snare on two and four, a looped two-bar jazz piano phrase, a walking upright bass under the loop, short muted-trumpet stabs punctuating the hook, hand claps doubling the snare in the hook. Dry and warm with almost no reverb, the drums and the rap forward, the piano loop centred and slightly dusty. Male voice rapping fast tongue-twisting Japanese with internal rhymes and a comic storyteller's timing, switching to a short shouted three-word chant on the hook. 92 BPM, A minor. Cocky and ridiculous. No trap hi-hat rolls, no 808 slides, no jersey club kick, no autotune, no sung pop chorus, no lo-fi chillhop haze, no chopped voice samples.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short drum break and piano loop]

[Verse 1]
七時五十五分 惣菜コーナーで待機
カゴは空 目線は店員の右手
ラベラーがカチッ それが試合開始
主婦 学生 じいちゃん 今夜は全員ライバル

[Pre-Chorus]
焦んな 走んな ここは店内
でも手だけは 誰より速い

[Chorus]

今夜の王様 レジ袋ひとつ

[Verse 2]
刺身は三割引 まだ動かない
半額まで待つ それが王のプライド
隣のじいちゃん 俺より先に手が伸びた
目が合って 「どうぞ」って 王なのに 譲ってもらった

[Chorus]
貼った 取った 勝った
半額 半額 刺身も 半額
貼った 取った 勝った
譲ってもらった王様 レジ袋ひとつ

[Outro - drum break, record stop]
レンジで二分
王の晩飯
[Song ends abruptly]

tracks.title: 鏡代わり
tracks.mood: hungry and proud
tracks.subject: five friends practising choreography at night in the dark glass of a closed office building
tracks.caption: Japanese dance-vocal boy-group pop, choreography-driven performance pop. A hard 808 sub bass with trap hi-hat rolls in the verses, switching to a four-on-the-floor house drop in the chorus, detuned synth chord stabs and short synth plucks, finger snaps and claps stacked on beats two and four, noise risers sweeping into each drop. Tight, punchy and wide, with the bass and the lead voices forward and the synths spread to the sides. Male group vocals with the parts split between members: a rapped verse, a smooth R&B voice with short runs, a belted top line, and stacked harmonies in the chorus. 124 BPM, D minor. Hungry and proud. No ballad section, no rock guitars, no autotune, no English verse, no key change, no chopped voice samples in the drop.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - 808 sub and finger snaps]

[Verse 1 - Rap]
夜十時 閉まったビルの前 ガラスが黒い
映ってるのは五人と スマホのスピーカー
警備員さん 今日も見て見ぬふり
ありがと 音はちょっとだけ下げる

[Pre-Chorus - smooth voice]
鏡のあるスタジオは 一時間二千円
俺らにはまだ 高すぎる

[Chorus - stacked harmonies]
このガラスが 鏡代わり
ズレてんの お前じゃない 俺だ
もう一回 頭から
終電まで あと四回

[Verse 2 - Rap]
通りすがりの酔っぱらいが 拍手して帰ってく
初めての客 一人 ネクタイ頭に巻いて
オーディション 二次で落ちた話は 誰もしない
しないから 踊れてる

[Chorus - stacked harmonies]
このガラスが 鏡代わり
ズレてんの お前じゃない 俺だ
もう一回 頭から
次はライトの下で 同じ振り

[Bridge - half-time, claps only]
ファイブ シックス セブン エイト
ガラスに 手の跡 増えてく

[Outro - 808 drops out]
ガラスを袖で拭いて 帰る
明日も十時

tracks.title: ミルクは二秒
tracks.mood: happily in love on a slow morning
tracks.subject: knowing exactly how long to pour the milk into your girlfriend's Sunday coffee
tracks.caption: Japanese R&B with a neo-soul feel. A Rhodes electric piano playing soft ninth and thirteenth chords, a round fingerstyle electric bass sliding between notes, laid-back drums sitting behind the beat with a soft side-stick, ghost notes and swung hi-hats, a muted electric guitar comping in short offbeat stabs. Warm and close, with tape saturation and a gentle low-pass on the drums, the voice and the Rhodes forward and the room small. Male voice, breathy and smooth in the chest, sliding up into falsetto on the hook, with short melismatic runs and stacked self-harmonies. 84 BPM, Eb major. Happily in love on a slow morning. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no four-on-the-floor, no big reverb, no string section, no city-pop slap bass or synth brass, no lo-fi drum machine or vinyl hiss.

[Intro - Rhodes chords and side-stick]

日曜の九時 君はまだ布団の中

マグは君の 青いやつ
取っ手が欠けてる それがいいらしい

[Pre-Chorus]
砂糖はいらない
ミルクは 数えなくても わかる

[Chorus]
ミルクは二秒

誰に教わったわけじゃない
半年 君の顔見てたら 覚えた

[Verse 2]
「なんでわかるの」って 寝ぐせのまま聞くから
「さあね」って言って 自分のを淹れる
俺のはブラック ほんとは苦手
君が「大人だね」って言ったから やめられない

[Chorus]
ミルクは二秒
注いで 止めて ちょうどいい茶色
誰に教わったわけじゃない

tracks.mood: furious, then laughing at it
tracks.subject: taking the train two stops to pay 2,500 yen and get your bicycle back from the city impound lot
tracks.caption: Japanese melodic punk in the melocore style. Two electric guitars playing downstroked power chords, palm-muted in the verses and opening into ringing chords in the chorus, fast two-beat punk drums with kick and snare alternating eighth notes and a crash on every bar, a pick-played bass doubling the root notes. Dry, tight and loud, the guitars wide left and right, the voice forward with no reverb tail. tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - palm-muted guitars and two-beat drums]

[Verse 1]
駅前の柵の横に 五分だけ停めた
ほんとに五分 パン買っただけ
戻ったら ない 黄色い紙が一枚
「撤去しました」 やけに丁寧な字で

[Pre-Chorus]
保管所は 二駅先の 川の向こう
自転車を取りに 電車で行く

[Chorus - gang shouts]
二千五百円!
五分で 二千五百円!
パンは百八十円 ふざけんな
今から取り返しに行く

[Verse 2]
保管所のおじさん 優しいのがむかつく
「みんなそうなんですよ」って 判子押す
千台並んだ中から 自分のを探す
サドルに貼った ガムテ 見つけた瞬間 ちょっと泣いた

[Chorus - gang shouts]
二千五百円!
五分で 二千五百円!
パンは百八十円 ふざけんな
帰りは川沿い 全力で漕ぐ

[Bridge - gang shouts]
オイ オイ
次は駐輪場
一日百円 払ってやるよ

[Outro - last chord rings, cut]
パン 潰れてた
[Song ends abruptly]

tracks.title: じいちゃん、うるせえ
tracks.mood: rowdy, sore-shouldered pride
tracks.subject: a first-timer carrying the neighbourhood mikoshi at the summer matsuri in a borrowed happi coat while an old barber shouts corrections from the roadside
tracks.caption: Japanese ska-punk. A horn section of trumpet, trombone, tenor and baritone saxophones playing unison riffs and short stabs, an upstroke guitar skank on every offbeat in the verses, a bouncing pick-played bass, backbeat drums with rimshots and fast hi-hats that switch to a punk two-beat with distorted guitars under the horns in the chorus. Loud, live and a little roomy like a small club, the horns forward and bright, guitars and bass tight underneath. Male lead voice shouting the lines with a rough edge, with the band answering in gang choruses. 168 BPM, Bb major. Rowdy, sore-shouldered pride. No reggae one-drop, no synths, no autotune, no slow ballad section, no key change.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - horn riff and offbeat guitar skank]

[Verse 1]
法被は 酒屋の兄ちゃんに借りた
袖が長くて 樟脳くさい
初めて入る 神輿の棒の下
右肩に 木がゴツンと乗っかる

[Pre-Chorus - band answers]
「肩 入れろ!」
床屋のじいちゃんが 沿道から叫ぶ
入れてるって!

[Chorus - lead calls, band answers]
わっしょい! わっしょい!
肩が痛え でも声は出す
わっしょい! わっしょい!
じいちゃん うるせえ 今やってる

[Verse 2]
鳥居の前で 一回下ろして 麦茶を飲む
肩は紫 タオル畳んで 挟み直す
「代わるか?」って聞かれて 首を振った
いつの間にか 前の人と 足が揃ってる

[Chorus - lead calls, band answers]
わっしょい! わっしょい!
肩が痛え でも声は出す
わっしょい! わっしょい!
じいちゃん 黙った 腕組んで 笑ってる

[Outro - horn stabs, cut]
法被を返しに行ったら じいちゃんが一言
「来年は 先棒な」
[Song ends abruptly]

[Intro - choir pad, then djent chugs]

[Verse 1]
朝六時 公園 ブルーシート 四畳半
新人だから 私が守る
部長は 十二時に来るって言った
今 六時 あと六時間

[Pre-Chorus - backing chant]
守れ! 守れ!
四隅に 石を置け!

[Chorus]
ここは 渡さない
隣の大学生にも 犬にも 風にも
桜の下の 四畳半
今日だけ 私は ここの女王

tracks.title: かき氷四杯目
tracks.mood: lovesick and brain-frozen
tracks.subject: ordering a fourth shaved ice at a beach hut just to talk to the girl behind the counter
tracks.caption: Japanese reggae in the Shonan sing-along style. One-drop drums with a cross-stick snare and the kick on beat three, an offbeat guitar skank and an organ bubble, a deep round dub bass, short brass stabs in the chorus, dub delay throws on the ends of vocal phrases. Warm and sunny with a deep low end, the bass and voices forward, the skank tight and the delays spreading wide. Two male voices trading parts: one toasting rhythmically in the verses like a deejay, one singing the hook, joined by a crowd sing-along in the last chorus. 88 BPM, G major. Lovesick and brain-frozen. No trap drums, no autotune, no four-on-the-floor, no rock guitar solo, no key change.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - organ bubble and one-drop]

[Verse 1 - toasting]
海の家 午後二時 店のねえちゃん
タオル巻いて 氷 削ってる
「何味?」って聞かれて 声 裏返った
いちごって言った ほんとはメロン派

[Pre-Chorus - sung]
食べ終わったら 話す理由がなくなる
だから もう一回 並ぶ

[Chorus - sung]
かき氷 四杯目
頭キーンってして 顔は笑ってる
名前 まだ聞けてない
次は レモンにしとく

[Verse 2 - toasting]
三杯目で 「好きだね」って笑われた
好きなのは 氷じゃないけど 黙ってた
腹は冷えて 唇 たぶん 青い
連れのやつらは 砂に埋まって 寝てる

[Chorus - crowd sing-along]
かき氷 四杯目
頭キーンってして 顔は笑ってる
「明日も来る?」って 向こうから
明日は メロンにする

[Outro - dub delay on the voice]
明日も来る
五杯目で 名前 聞く

tracks.title: ネジが一本余る
tracks.mood: deadpan irritation that ends in a shrug
tracks.subject: finishing a flat-pack bookshelf alone and finding one screw left over on the floor
tracks.caption: Japanese math rock. Two clean electric guitars playing interlocking two-hand tapped lines and short stabbing riffs, a melodic electric bass tapping its own counter-lines, drums shifting between 7/8 and 4/4 with sudden full stops and accented fills, light overdrive kicked on for the chorus. Dry and close, a small room with the kit miked from the room, every instrument separated and the bass loud. Female voice, deadpan and talky in the verses, breaking into a shout at the chorus peaks, with short group harmonies from the band. 150 BPM, F# minor. Deadpan irritation that ends in a shrug. No four-on-the-floor, no synths, no autotune, no long reverb, no ballad section, no straight-eighth indie-rock strumming, no pop-punk power chords.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - tapped guitars in 7/8]

[Verse 1]
説明書は絵だけ 文字が一個もない
棚板四枚 六角レンチ一本
二時間かけて立てた 本も入れた
床に ネジが 一本 残ってる

[Pre-Chorus]
袋を見る 絵を見る
数は合ってる はずだった

[Chorus]
ネジが一本 余る
どこのネジか わかんない
揺らしても 揺れない
じゃあ お前は 何なの

[Verse 2]
もう一回 全部外すのは 嫌
漫画 四十冊 もう入れちゃった
ネジは小皿に置いて 見ないふり
夜中 棚が鳴った気がして 起きる

[Chorus]
ネジが一本 余る
どこのネジか わかんない
揺らしても 揺れない
今日から お前は お守り

[Bridge - drums stop, bass alone]
説明書 裏返したら
小さい字で 「予備 一本」

[Outro - full stop]
先に言ってよ
[Song ends abruptly]

tracks.title: 透明な傘
tracks.mood: melodramatically betrayed over something small
tracks.subject: someone taking your clear plastic umbrella from the stand outside a convenience store on a rainy night
tracks.caption: Japanese visual kei rock, gothic rock with a speed-metal drive, theatrical. A short harpsichord intro, drop-tuned twin electric guitars switching between chorus-drenched clean arpeggios and fast tremolo-picked heavy riffs, a driving eighth-note bass, double-kick drums with hard unison stops, gothic synth pads under the chorus. Dark and dense but clear, the guitars wide, the voice forward with a long hall reverb only on the held notes. Male lead voice, theatrical, moving from a low dark croon in the verses to a high falsetto in the chorus with heavy vibrato, with one short harsh scream in the bridge. 168 BPM, B minor. Melodramatically betrayed over something small. No rapping, no autotune, no pop-punk chorus, no acoustic guitar, no EDM drop, no djent chugs, no blast beats, no choir.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - harpsichord, then guitars crash in]

[Verse 1]
午後十一時 雨 コンビニの前
傘立てに置いた 透明な 私の傘
取っ手に貼った 小さな 薔薇のシール
レジで 肉まんを待つ 四十秒

[Pre-Chorus]
自動ドアが 開いた その時
残っていたのは 知らない傘 三本

[Chorus]
ああ 誰が 連れ去った
五百円の 透明な 恋人
同じ顔した 傘なら そこに三本
なぜ 薔薇の付いた 私のを

[Verse 2]
濡れて歩く 肉まんを 胸に抱いて
信号の赤が 血の色に見える
他人の傘は 取らない それが私の美学
たとえ 三本 余っていても

[Chorus]
ああ 誰が 連れ去った
五百円の 透明な 恋人
同じ顔した 傘なら そこに三本
罪を知れ 薔薇は あなたを 覚えてる

[Bridge - one scream, then clean arpeggio]
返せ!
明日 また 五百円で 買う

[Outro - harpsichord alone]

tracks.title: また同じ歌
tracks.mood: teasing tenderness after forty years
tracks.subject: an old wife on Amami teasing her husband for playing the same sanshin song every evening for forty years
tracks.caption: Amami island shima-uta folk with a light modern frame. An Amami sanshin tuned high and played with a thin bamboo pick, picking a bright repeating melody with small slides, a chijin hand drum giving sparse accents, hand claps from the backing singers in the chorus, a soft brushed drum kit and a low ambient pad entering only in the second half. Intimate and roomy like a porch at night, sanshin and voice forward, everything else low and far back. Female lead voice, high, with long drawn-out vowels and sudden flips into falsetto in the Amami guin style, answered by an older male voice in call-and-response. 84 BPM, A minor pentatonic. Teasing tenderness after forty years. No Okinawan Ryukyu-scale melody, no eisa taiko, no Okinawan pop band arrangement, no enka vibrato or orchestra, no autotune, no electric guitar, no four-on-the-floor.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short free-time sanshin]

[Verse 1 - female]
晩ごはん片付けて 縁側に出ると
あんたは もう 三線 抱えてる
四十年 毎晩 同じ一曲
蚊取り線香と 同じくらい 決まってる

[Pre-Chorus - female]
たまには 違うの 弾いたらって
言うと 黙って 糸を締め直す

[Chorus - female]
また 同じ歌 また 同じ歌
あんたが 十九の 夏に
うちの垣根の外で 弾いた歌
[Chorus - male answer]
同じでいい 同じでいい

[Verse 2 - female]
初めて聴いたのは 夜の九時ごろ
下手くそで 三回 間違えて
父ちゃんが 石を投げに 出ていった
あんたは逃げて 次の晩も来た

[Chorus - female]
また 同じ歌 また 同じ歌
今でも ちょっと 下手くそで
続きは 私が 歌ってやる
[Chorus - male answer]
同じでいい 同じでいい

[Outro - sanshin and claps, fading]
もう一回 弾きな
蚊が来る前に

tracks.title: 옆방 드러머
tracks.mood: a giddy crush you can't say out loud
tracks.subject: booking the same Thursday rehearsal-room slot every week to pass the drummer from the room next door
tracks.caption: Korean girl-band rock built like an anime opening theme. Two overdriven electric guitars play a unison sixteenth-note lead riff as the main hook, with tapping fills and a short shred solo before the last chorus. A picked electric bass doubles the root in straight eighths. A tight live rock kit plays a two-beat kick-snare pattern under the verses, eighth-note hi-hats over a four-on-the-floor kick in the pre-chorus, then opens to eighth-note crash-ride with a hard backbeat snare in the chorus. A bright piano and synth-string layer sits under the chorus. The band mix is tight and loud: guitars wide left and right, vocal on top, short room reverb. Bright, high, belted female lead with fast clipped syllables in the verses and long held notes in the chorus; bandmates double the title line in unison. Half-step key change into the final chorus. 180 BPM, E major. A giddy crush that won't come out of her mouth. No idol dance-pop beat, no indie jangle, no shoegaze wash, no trap drums, no autotune, no EDM drop.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - twin overdriven guitars in a unison sixteenth-note riff]

[Verse 1]
목요일 일곱 시 합주실 3번 방
벽 너머로 킥 드럼이 쿵쿵 넘어와
네 번째 곡에서 꼭 한 박자 빨라지는 너
내 심장이 그 박자에 먼저 따라 뛰어

[Pre-Chorus]
자판기 앞에서 마주치려고
캔커피를 세 번이나 뽑았어

[Chorus]
옆방 드러머, 너 이름이 뭐야
스틱 끝 다 닳은 거 나만 봤지
한 마디만 하면 되는데
"오늘 좀 빨랐어" 그 말만 맴돌아

[Verse 2]
예약표엔 매주 똑같은 내 이름
사장님이 웃으면서 "또 왔네" 해
오늘은 네가 문을 잡아 줬는데
고맙단 말 대신 기침만 나왔어

[Chorus]
옆방 드러머, 너 이름이 뭐야

다음 주엔 진짜 말할 거야
아니, 그다음 주엔 진짜로

[Chorus - half-step key change]
옆방 드러머, 너 이름이 뭐야
스틱 끝 다 닳은 거 나만 봤지
한 마디만 하면 되는데
"나 3번 방이야" 드디어 말해 버렸어

[Outro - guitars ring out on one chord]
쿵, 벽 너머로 대답이 왔어

tracks.mood: flirting on rental skates
tracks.subject: the couples-only song at a retro roller rink, and the boyfriend who said he could skate
tracks.caption: New jack swing revival in the early-90s Korean dance-pop style. A swung sixteenth-note drum-machine groove with a hard gated, reverbed snare on two and four and busy syncopated kicks. Synth-brass and orchestra-hit stabs land on the off-beats. A Rhodes-style electric piano plays ninth chords, and a funky programmed synth bass moves in sixteenths. Fully programmed and tight, punchy drums forward, brass stabs spread wide, vocals stacked in the center, no live-band feel. Smooth, light female lead, breathy in the verses, with stacked group harmonies on the chorus and a short half-spoken bridge. 108 BPM, C minor. Flirting while holding each other up. No trap hi-hats, no live slap bass, no slow R&B ballad tempo, no autotune, no EDM drop.

tracks.caption: Eurodance idol pop with a hardstyle kick drop, in the 2025 Korean girl-group revival style. A four-on-the-floor kick under an offbeat, octave-bouncing synth bass. A supersaw lead plays stab chords, and a bright 90s piano-house riff carries the chorus. In the drop a distorted hardstyle reverse-bass kick takes over. Snare-roll risers and white-noise sweeps lead into each chorus. Loud, wide and club-bright, with kick and bass forward and the lead vocal centered above the supersaws. Female lead with a chanted, half-rapped verse and a belted chorus, shouting the English cue word 'jump' on the hook. 140 BPM, A minor. Friday-night release after a bad week. No trap hi-hats, no ballad breakdown, no autotune warble, no dubstep wobble, no gritty electroclash synths.

tracks.mood: two neighbours slowly admitting why they come downstairs
tracks.subject: two neighbours from the seventh and twelfth floors who only ever meet at the recycling bins on Wednesday night
tracks.caption: Korean original musical theatre number, a two-character book-song duet in the Daehangno small-theatre style. A piano-led pit band that opens with rubato solo piano. A violin and a cello swell under the bridge, an upright bass walks softly, a light brushed drum kit enters at the first chorus, and a clarinet answers the vocal lines. Intimate, roomy small-theatre sound with natural hall reverb, piano and voices forward, strings behind. Two voices in sung dialogue, a clear female mixed belt and a warm male baritone with crisp diction, trading lines and joining in harmony on the chorus; the strings lift into a key change for the final chorus. 96 BPM, F major. Shy neighbours who both know why they keep coming downstairs. No K-ballad or drama-OST power build, no pop drum loop, no synths, no rock guitar, no trap, no autotune.

tracks.caption: Korean children's sing-along song in the bright TV-character style. A glockenspiel doubles the melody as the hook. A ukulele strums bouncy eighth notes, a toy-like square-wave synth answers each line, and hand claps and a shaker sit on every beat over a clean, simple pop kit with a bouncy two-beat feel. Bright, clean and close, with glockenspiel and lead vocal forward in a small room. A clear, bright adult female lead sings clearly and simply enough for a small child to follow, one syllable per note, and a children's chorus sings the parenthesised answers and the counting. 120 BPM, G major. A busy, cheerful picnic-morning kitchen. No rap, no dance break, no minor key, no heavy bass drop, no adult pop belting, no autotune.

tracks.title: 백팔 번째
tracks.mood: hungover devotion played for laughs
tracks.subject: doing a hundred and eight prostrations at a temple stay with a hangover
tracks.caption: Buddhist sutra EDM in the Korean temple-club style. A four-on-the-floor club kick with a rolling offbeat bass, and dry, dark techno synth stabs, building by adding layers rather than snare rolls. A wooden moktak (temple wood block) is played live on every beat as the lead percussion, and temple-bell hits and the crack of a jukbi bamboo clapper mark each new section and each bow. Club-loud and wide, with kick and moktak forward and long bell tails. A male lead chants the verses in a deadpan monotone as a rhythmic hook, then switches to a hype-MC voice shouting the counts in the chorus; the chant is sung live, not looped. 128 BPM, D minor. Hungover devotion played for laughs. No trap drums, no pop ballad singing, no autotune, no gugak orchestra, no shamanic funk groove, no supersaw leads, no Eurodance piano.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short, four bars of moktak and one temple bell]

[Verse 1 - deadpan chant]
새벽 네 시, 목탁이 울립니다
어젯밤 마신 소주가 아직 남았습니다
수련복 바지는 발목이 다 드러납니다
지금부터 백팔 배를 시작합니다

[Pre-Chorus - hype shout]
무릎 꿇어, 이마 대, 일어나
다시 꿇어, 이마 대, 일어나

[Chorus]
하나! 둘! 셋! 나무아미타불
열! 스물! 서른! 나무아미타불
종아리가 떨려도 숫자는 안 멈춰
백팔 번째까지 가 보자고

[Verse 2 - deadpan chant]
쉰 번째 절에서 술이 깹니다
일흔 번째 절에서 전 애인이 떠오릅니다
여든 번째 절에서 그것도 내려놓습니다
아흔 번째, 옆 사람 방석이 젖었습니다

[Bridge - one temple bell, beat drops out]
다 내려놓으십시오
배고픔만은 내려놓지 마십시오

[Chorus]
백육! 백칠! 나무아미타불
백팔! 끝! 나무아미타불
종아리가 떨려도 숫자는 다 셌어
아침 공양 미역국 먹으러 가자고

[Outro - moktak alone, slowing]
성불하십시오
공양간은 왼쪽입니다

tracks.title: 소떡소떡
tracks.mood: a rowdy road trip that never reaches the sea on time
tracks.subject: four friends stopping at every highway rest stop on the way to the east coast and eating something at each
tracks.caption: Chosun punk in the Hongdae party-punk revival style. Fast three-chord electric guitars downstroked with an open crunch tone, not drop-tuned. A pumping eighth-note bass under drums in a punk-polka two-beat, kick and snare alternating oom-pah at speed. An accordion plays the main riff and answers the vocal. A raw live-room recording, everything loud and close, accordion and gang vocals forward. A shouted, sneering male lead, with the whole band joining in gang sing-alongs on the parenthesised lines. 190 BPM, A major. A rowdy road trip that never gets to the sea on time. No drop-tuned metal riffs, no glossy pop-punk production, no post-punk gloom, no ska upstrokes, no slow ballad section, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - accordion riff over three-chord guitars]

[Verse 1]
새벽 다섯 시, 강릉 간다고 출발
첫 휴게소에서 호두과자 한 봉지
두 번째 휴게소 감자 핫도그 네 개
운전은 막내, 먹는 건 우리 셋

[Pre-Chorus]
바다는 언제 보냐고? 몰라!
배부르면 그때 생각해!

[Chorus]
소떡소떡! (소떡소떡!)
소시지 떡 소시지 떡!
휴게소 다 들러, 강릉은 그다음
소떡소떡! (하나 더!)

[Verse 2]
횡성에선 한우 국밥, 평창에선 옥수수
대관령 넘다가 막내가 화장실 급해
내비가 말하네, 도착까지 이십 분
출발한 지는 벌써 열두 시간째

[Chorus]
소떡소떡! (소떡소떡!)
소시지 떡 소시지 떡!
대관령 넘어도 바다는 그다음
소떡소떡! (하나 더!)

[Bridge - gang-vocal breakdown over accordion and drums]
바다 바다 바다 어디 있어
경포대 도착하니 해가 졌어

[Chorus]
소떡소떡! (소떡소떡!)
소시지 떡 소시지 떡!
바다는 깜깜, 회는 내일 먹어
돌아가는 길에 또 소떡소떡! (하나 더!)

[Outro - accordion and gang shout]
다음 휴게소 십 킬로미터!
막내야, 들러!

tracks.title: 천 일째
tracks.mood: sheepish, happy and in no hurry
tracks.subject: both forgetting your thousandth day together and celebrating it at a tteokbokki stall anyway
tracks.caption: Korean bossa nova in the acoustic Brazilian style, felt in two. A nylon-string classical guitar plays the bossa batida, thumb bass on one and three under syncopated finger chords in major sevenths and ninths. Brushes on the snare with a cross-stick rim pattern and a light kick. An upright bass plays root and fifth, and a soft muted trumpet answers the vocal and takes a short solo. Acoustic, live, dry and close, with guitar and voice forward and no reverb wash. A soft, close-mic female voice, near-spoken, with little vibrato and gentle phrasing behind the beat. 118 BPM, D major. Sheepish, happy and in no hurry. No programmed beats, no lo-fi hip-hop drums, no pop ballad build, no electric guitar, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - nylon guitar batida and brushes]

[Verse 1]
퇴근길 사 호선에서 알림이 떴어
오늘은 우리 천 일째 되는 날
꽃집은 벌써 셔터를 내렸고
내 손엔 우산 하나랑 교통카드뿐

[Pre-Chorus]
너한테 전화했더니
너도 방금 봤대, 그 알림

[Chorus]
천 일째엔 떡볶이를 먹자
시장 입구 포장마차, 의자 두 개
어묵 국물 한 컵 더 달라고 하면서
우리 둘 다 잊었으니까 괜찮아

[Verse 2]
이모가 무슨 날이냐고 묻길래
넌 그냥 화요일이래, 웃으면서
순대 몇 개 서비스로 얹어 주시고
우린 영수증 뒤에 천이라고 썼어

[Bridge - muted trumpet solo, then voice]
이천 일째도 아마 잊을 거야
그때도 여기 오자, 알림 없어도

[Chorus]
천 일째엔 떡볶이를 먹자
시장 입구 포장마차, 의자 두 개
네 입가에 묻은 고추장 닦아 주면서
우리 둘 다 잊었어도 괜찮아

[Outro - nylon guitar and brushes, slowing]
천 일 하고 한 시간째
아직 여기 앉아 있어

tracks.title: Bawa Dia Balik Raya
tracks.mood: showing her off, nervous and in love
tracks.subject: a girlfriend's first Raya in the kampung and the moment she tells Mak Ngah her rendang needs more kerisik
tracks.caption: Malaysian Hari Raya festive pop in the lagu raya style. A kompang ensemble playing interlocking unison accents in the intro and every fill, rebana with layered hand claps on 2 and 4, a bright accordion answering each vocal line, acoustic guitar strumming on the offbeat, and a straight 4/4 pop kit with a single gong hit on each section change. Bright and full, roomy like a kampung house veranda, the kompang forward in the fills and the vocals clearly on top. Warm, smiling male lead in a comfortable mid register, with a mixed family gang-vocal chorus answering him. 112 BPM, D major. Showing her off, nervous and in love. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no 6/8 joget lilt, no devotional hush.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - kompang roll and accordion pickup]

[Verse 1]
Pagi raya pertama aku bawa dia balik
Baju kurung hijau pucuk pisang, dia gosok sendiri semalam
Kereta baru masuk simpang, Mak Long dah tercegat kat tangga
Tiga mak cik, soalan sama: "Orang mana? Kerja apa?"

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku nak jawab, dia jawab dulu
Senyum, salam, cium tangan, terus masuk dapur

[Chorus]
Bawa dia balik raya, satu kampung nak tengok
(Siapa tu? Siapa tu?)
Mak Long tanya bila nak hantar rombongan
Aku senyum, makan ketupat, buat-buat tak dengar

[Verse 2]
Rendang Mak Ngah dia rasa, dia kata "kurang kerisik sikit"
Satu dapur senyap, sudip pun berhenti
Mak Ngah pandang lama, lepas tu ketawa kuat
"Budak ni boleh pakai" - tu pujian paling tinggi kat rumah ni

[Bridge - kompang drops out, accordion and voice]
Malam raya kedua, dia duduk sebelah aku kat tangga
"Keluarga awak bising," dia kata, "tahun depan saya datang lagi"

[Chorus]
Bawa dia balik raya, satu kampung nak tengok
(Siapa tu? Siapa tu?)
Mak Ngah dah minta nombor telefon dia
Aku pula yang kena basuh periuk sorang-sorang

[Outro - kompang and family singalong]
Minta maaf zahir batin, Mak Long
Tahun depan, tak payah tanya lagi

tracks.title: Bendera Blok C
tracks.mood: proud, loud and a little chaotic
tracks.subject: neighbours hanging a fifteen-storey flag down the side of their flats on the night of 30 August
tracks.caption: Malaysian Merdeka patriotic anthem in the modern lagu perpaduan style. A marching snare playing military rudiments that turns into big half-time pop-rock drums with floor-tom builds, a French horn and trumpet fanfare between lines, a driving orchestral string ostinato, piano carrying the verses, and overdriven rhythm guitars thickening the chorus. Starts close and narrow with piano and snare, then opens wide for the chorus, with a stacked mixed choir in the final chorus after a key change up. Proud, declamatory male lead in a strong tenor, with massed unison group vocals and chanted refrains. 92 BPM, Bb major. Proud, loud and a little chaotic. No trap drums, no autotune, no EDM synths, no intimate whisper vocal, no slow-ballad tempo drop.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - marching snare and horn fanfare]

[Verse 1]
Tiga puluh Ogos, pukul sepuluh malam
Uncle Lim tingkat lima belas pegang tali, tangan menggigil
Kak Yati bawa cable tie satu plastik penuh
Anak Muthu jerit dari bawah, "Kiri sikit! Kiri lagi!"

[Pre-Chorus]
Bendera ni panjang lima belas tingkat
Jahit sendiri, tiga minggu kat bawah blok

[Chorus]
Turun, turun, Blok C!
(Blok C! Blok C!)
Jalur Gemilang lalu depan tingkap semua orang
Esok pagi orang lalu tol pun boleh nampak

[Verse 2]
Tingkat sembilan tersangkut kat aircon rumah Pak Abu
Pak Abu keluar berkain pelikat, panjat kerusi, tarik sekali
Satu blok tepuk tangan, ada yang rakam, ada yang hon motor
Pak guard tinggal pondok, datang suluh dengan lampu picit

[Bridge - snare roll, choir enters, key change up]
Bintang empat belas bucu, ada tiga yang senget
Kak Yati kata biar, baru orang tahu kita yang jahit

[Chorus]
Turun, turun, Blok C!
(Blok C! Blok C!)
Jalur Gemilang lalu depan tingkap semua orang
Pagi tiga puluh satu, Uncle Lim nak bergambar kat bawah

[Outro - choir chant over big drums]
Merdeka! Blok C!
Tingkat sembilan, terima kasih, Pak Abu

tracks.title: Empat Murtabak
tracks.mood: hungry, giddy and racing the clock to buka puasa
tracks.subject: three housemates' first Ramadan bazaar run at 6 p.m. with twenty ringgit each, splitting up to cover the stalls and coming back with four murtabak and no drinks
tracks.caption: 1990s Malay boyband pop in the KRU swingbeat style, with revival production. Swung sixteenth-note drum-machine programming with a hard gated snare and a boomy kick, short synth-bass stabs, orchestra hits and brass stabs on the downbeats, DX-style electric piano chords, and muted funk guitar chops on the offbeats. Retro early-90s mix, dry and punchy in the drums, with chorus and reverb on the backing harmonies and the bass and snare forward. Three-part male group harmony on the hooks, a smooth lead tenor in the verses, one rapped verse in Malay, and shouted group call-outs. 108 BPM, A minor. Hungry, giddy and racing the clock to buka puasa. No trap hi-hats, no 808 slides, no autotune, no EDM drop, no modern TikTok loop.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - orchestra hit and swung drum machine]

[Verse 1]
Pukul enam petang, tiga orang keluar Kancil, parking tepi longkang
Dua puluh ringgit seorang, duit rumah sewa, gaji belum masuk
Aku ambil ayam percik, Amir ambil kuih, Danial tugas cari air
"Jumpa kat pintu pagar pukul tujuh, jangan beli benda merepek!"

[Pre-Chorus]
Bau arang, bau santan, aku lalu depan gerai murtabak dulu
"Satu je, bang, untuk rumah" - ayam percik aku lupa terus

[Chorus]
Empat murtabak, satu air pun tak ada
(Hoi! Bertiga!)
Dah janji pecah tiga, semua sangkut kat gerai yang sama
Abang murtabak gelak, "Kawan korang baru beli tadi!"

[Verse 2 - Rap]
Aku Danial, kerja aku satu je, beli air tiga bungkus
Sirap bandung, tebu, kelapa, aku hafal dari rumah sampai lorong
Tapi lalu depan gerai murtabak, abang tu tebar roti tinggi-tinggi
Dua puluh ringgit tinggal empat, tangan kiri aku pegang dua bungkus

[Bridge - breakdown, kick and snare only]
Pintu pagar pukul tujuh, aku angkat satu, Amir angkat satu, Danial angkat dua
Tujuh lima belas, Kancil tersangkut belakang bas, lapan minit lagi nak buka

[Chorus]
Empat murtabak, satu air pun tak ada
(Hoi! Bertiga!)
Dah janji pecah tiga, semua sangkut kat gerai yang sama
Sampai rumah, air kosong dalam cerek, tiga gelas, cukuplah tu

[Outro - group call-outs over the drum machine]
Radio dah bunyi azan! Tiga, dua, satu - buka!
Esok aku pegang duit semua!

tracks.title: Belum Tempah Grab
tracks.mood: falling for someone and stalling on purpose
tracks.subject: a first date at a café that runs to closing time because the rain gives you both an excuse
tracks.caption: Malay jazz-pop in the Sheila Majid lineage, a light mid-tempo smooth jazz-pop groove. A Rhodes electric piano comping with ninth, eleventh and thirteenth voicings over ii-V-I changes, a fretless electric bass sliding between roots with short melodic fills, a live drum kit played light with sidestick on the snare, a soft ride cymbal and ghost notes, a soprano saxophone answering the vocal and taking a short solo before the last chorus, and a clean chorused jazz guitar comping in short chords. Warm and close, a polished late-80s studio sound with soft plate reverb, Rhodes and voice forward, the sax slightly back. Smooth female alto phrased slightly behind the beat, clean diction, no belting, a few light scat ad-libs. 96 BPM, F major. Falling for someone and stalling on purpose. No bossa nova, no funk horn section, no slap bass, no programmed R&B beats, no power-ballad chorus, no autotune, no trap, no big string build.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes chords and sidestick]

[Verse 1]
Kopi kedua dah sejuk, kek pandan tinggal separuh
Hujan kat luar cermin turun macam tak nak berhenti
Awak cerita pasal kucing jiran yang selalu tidur dalam kasut awak
Aku ketawa kuat sangat, orang meja sebelah toleh

[Pre-Chorus]
Telefon aku dalam beg, bateri tujuh puluh peratus
Aku tak keluarkan pun

[Chorus]
Aku belum tempah Grab
Hujan ni alasan paling elok aku pernah dapat
Kalau awak tanya, aku cakap surge mahal sangat
Padahal aku cuma nak dengar awak habiskan cerita

[Verse 2]
Pelayan dah susun kerusi atas meja hujung
Awak minta satu lagi teh tarik, "kurang manis, terima kasih"
Payung awak kecil, payung aku tertinggal kat pejabat
Kalau kongsi pun, kena jalan rapat sikit lah

[Bridge - soprano sax solo, then the voice returns]
Pukul sepuluh, separuh lampu kafe dah tutup
Awak pun belum sentuh telefon awak

[Chorus]
Aku belum tempah Grab
Hujan dah berhenti sepuluh minit tadi, kita buat-buat tak nampak
Kalau awak tanya, aku cakap surge mahal sangat
Padahal aku cuma nak dengar awak habiskan cerita

[Outro - Rhodes alone, light scat]
Jalan kaki je lah
Stesen LRT tak jauh, kan?

tracks.title: Kereta Sia Bah
tracks.mood: cheeky outrage, all bark and no bite
tracks.subject: a cousin who borrowed your Myvi for one day and brought it back a week later from Kudat
tracks.caption: Sabahan pop-rock band sound with Sabah Malay slang, radio-friendly. Twin electric guitars, one playing a clean chorus-pedal riff through the verses and both switching to crunchy overdrive in the chorus, a Hammond-style organ pumping chords, an electric bass locked to the kick, and straight-eighth rock drums opening up the hi-hat in the chorus. Live band in a medium room, guitars panned wide, organ in the middle, the lead vocal forward and dry. High-energy male lead in a bright upper register, cheeky and storytelling, with gang-shout answers in the chorus and a big singalong outro. 128 BPM, E major. Cheeky outrage, all bark and no bite. No autotune, no trap 808s, no drum machine, no moody alt-rock fuzz, no ballad slowdown.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - clean chorus-pedal guitar riff and drum fill]

[Verse 1]
Isnin lepas sepupu sia datang, senyum lebar macam baru dapat gaji
"Pinjam kereta sehari ja, sia pigi Tuaran hantar barang"
Sia kasi kunci, sia kasi minyak penuh
Sekarang sudah Ahad, telefon pun dia inda angkat

[Pre-Chorus]
Tiba-tiba Facebook dia naik gambar
Myvi sia di Hujung Borneo, ada orang berdiri atas bumbung

[Chorus]
Kereta sia bah! (Kereta dia bah!)
Sehari ko cakap, sudah enam hari
Kereta sia bah! (Kereta dia bah!)
Balik nanti ko basuh, ko isi, ko bayar saman

[Verse 2]
Isnin pagi kereta balik, pasir penuh dalam karpet
Ada sebiji kelapa muda bergolek bawah kerusi belakang
Radio sia tersangkut di stesen yang sia inda kenal
Dia hulur sepuluh ringgit, "Untuk minyak, bah, jangan marah"

[Bridge - guitars drop out, drums and gang vocal only]
Sia mau marah, tapi dia bawa ikan masin Kudat satu plastik
Mak sia sudah senyum - habis, sia kalah lagi

[Chorus]
Kereta sia bah! (Kereta dia bah!)
Sehari ko cakap, jadi tujuh hari
Kereta sia bah! (Kereta dia bah!)
Bulan depan dia pinjam lagi, sia kasi lagi, palui!

[Outro - singalong over open hi-hat]
Kunci sia mana, bah?
Bawah tikar, kunun!

tracks.title: Baris Belakang
tracks.mood: flirty and teasing, sweaty Thursday-night fun
tracks.subject: the clumsy man in the back row of the Thursday Zumba class at the community hall
tracks.caption: Malay reggaeton, Spanish-Malay Latin pop. A dembow riddim with the kick on every beat and a rimshot snare on the tresillo pattern, on the 'a' of one and the 'and' of two, repeated in the second half of the bar, timbale and rimshot fills at the ends of phrases, a deep sub-bass following the kick, a plucked nylon-string guitar hook doubled by a marimba-like synth, and reverse-cymbal risers into each chorus. Tight and dry, sub-heavy, the guitar hook and lead vocal forward, narrow verses opening wider on the chorus. Female lead, half-sung and half-rapped in Malay in the verses, a girl-group unison chorus, Spanish tag words on the hook, breathy ad-libs. 94 BPM, G minor. Flirty and teasing, sweaty Thursday-night fun. No house groove, no open-hat EDM pulse, no trap hi-hat rolls, no autotune, no dangdut kendang, no EDM drop.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - nylon guitar hook and rimshot]

[Verse 1]
Khamis malam, dewan orang ramai, kipas siling pusing perlahan
Cikgu Zumba jerit "kanan!", satu dewan pergi kanan
Kecuali dia, baris belakang, pakai baju larian tahun lepas
Dia pergi kiri, tersengih, minta maaf kat semua orang

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku patut tengok cermin depan
Tapi cermin tu pun tunjuk dia

[Chorus]
Baris belakang, dale, dale
Langkah kau salah, aku tak kisah
Baila conmigo, kalau kau berani
Minggu depan kau berdiri sebelah aku

[Verse 2]
Lagu ketiga, baju dia dah basah lencun
Botol air dia warna pink, ada nama anak buah dia
Lepas kelas dia tolong lipat tikar semua orang
Aku ambil masa lama sangat ikat tali kasut

[Bridge - rimshot and nylon guitar only]
Parking dewan dah gelap, dia tunggu aku hidupkan motor
"Khamis depan kau datang?" - aku buat-buat fikir dulu

[Chorus]
Baris belakang, dale, dale
Langkah kau salah, aku tak kisah
Baila conmigo, kalau kau berani
Minggu depan aku yang pindah ke belakang

[Outro - dembow and guitar hook, fading]
Khamis depan, pukul lapan
Aku simpan tempat, jangan lambat

tracks.title: Sila Cuba Lagi
tracks.mood: fed up and shouting about it
tracks.subject: a toll gate rejecting your Touch 'n Go card five times on a Monday morning while a sand lorry and twenty cars honk behind you
tracks.caption: Malay pop-punk in the fast skate-punk style. Double-tracked distorted guitars playing palm-muted downstroke power chords in the verses and open ringing chords in the chorus, a melodic electric bass running between the chords, and skate-punk two-beat drums in the verses that open up to a straight-eighth beat on the crash-ride with the snare on two and four in the chorus, with fast tom fills and stop-start breaks. Loud and tight, guitars panned hard left and right, drums punchy and dry, the lead vocal forward over the wall. Earnest, slightly nasal male lead with whoa-oh gang vocals and shout-along hooks. 176 BPM, A major. Fed up and shouting about it. No autotune, no trap drums, no synths, no slow emo ballad section, no metal growls.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - palm-muted guitar and snare count-in]

[Verse 1]
Isnin, pukul enam empat puluh pagi, plaza tol, lorong paling kanan
Aku tap kad, palang tak naik, skrin kuning berkelip
"Sila cuba lagi" - aku cuba lagi, aku cuba sampai lima kali
Belakang aku lori pasir, belakang lori dua puluh kereta

[Pre-Chorus]
Hon pertama, hon kedua, lepas tu satu lebuh raya
Whoa-oh, whoa-oh, aku tak boleh undur

[Chorus]
Sila cuba lagi!
Baki aku ada, semalam aku dah tambah nilai
Kad ni sama umur dengan kereta aku, dua-dua dah penat
Aku keluar kereta, angkat tangan, "Maaf, bang! Maaf semua!"

[Verse 2]
Pegawai tol keluar dari pondok, jalan perlahan macam hari Ahad
Dia ambil kad aku, gosok kat seluar, tap sekali - palang naik
Dia tak cakap apa-apa, dia cuma angkat kening
Lori pasir hon panjang macam dia yang menang

[Bridge - stop-start breaks, gang shout]
Pasang SmartTAG! (Pasang SmartTAG!)
Esok aku naik LRT! (Tipu! Tipu!)

[Chorus]
Sila cuba lagi!
Baki aku ada, semalam aku dah tambah nilai
Kad ni sama umur dengan kereta aku, dua-dua dah penat
Selasa pagi, lorong sama, skrin sama: "Sila cuba lagi"

[Outro - full band, one last whoa-oh, then stop]
Whoa-oh, whoa-oh
Seluar aku pun dah tahu kerja dia
[Song ends abruptly]

tracks.title: Gula Melaka
tracks.mood: a long marriage, bickering sweetly
tracks.subject: an old Melaka couple trading pantun over who forgot to buy gula melaka for the kenduri cendol
tracks.caption: Dondang sayang, the traditional Melaka pantun duet, in an acoustic stage style. A solo violin opening with a short ornamented melody and answering every sung line, rebana frame drums keeping a slow swaying 4/4, a soft gong marking the end of each pantun, and an accordion holding quiet sustained chords underneath. Sparse and acoustic, a roomy wooden-hall sound, the violin and both voices forward, percussion light and behind. Male and female duet trading four-line pantun, gentle and ornamented with cengkok turns, teasing and conversational, older voices with warmth. 68 BPM, D minor. A long marriage, bickering sweetly. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no harmonium or tabla, no keroncong ukulele, no pop chorus build, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - solo violin, short ornamented phrase]

[Verse 1 - Female]
Pergi ke Jonker membeli tembikar
Singgah sebentar di Bukit Cina
Santan dah perah, api dah besar
Gula Melaka, abang, mana?

[Verse 2 - Male]
Anak ikan di Sungai Melaka
Berenang jauh ke Pulau Besar
Abang terlupa, bukan sengaja
Terleka berbual di tepi pasar

[Chorus - Duet]
Gula Melaka, oh gula Melaka
Tiga puluh tahun, masih juga terlupa
Sudip di tangan, Jah tunggu di tangga
Abang balik bawa cucur, bukan gula

[Verse 3 - Male]
Pokok kelapa di Tanjung Kling
Daunnya melambai ditiup bayu
Abang ke kedai, motor dah pusing
Bawa gula, bawa bunga, Jah tersipu malu

[Bridge - violin alone, then the female voice, softer]
Bunga melur di dalam pasu
Disiram pagi, harum ke senja
Tiga puluh tahun Jah dah tahu
Abang lupa memang sengaja

[Chorus - Duet]
Gula Melaka, oh gula Melaka
Tiga puluh tahun, masih juga terlupa
Sudip di tangan, Jah tunggu di tangga
Esok abang lupa lagi, Jah ikut sama

[Outro - violin and gong, slow ending]

tracks.title: Tampal Lagi
tracks.mood: deadpan satire, marching and grinning
tracks.subject: a pothole outside the market patched three times in one month, each time the night before an official visit
tracks.caption: Boria, the Penang satirical chorus song, in a brisk stage-show style. A violin playing a bright march-like melody and answering the lead, an accordion pumping chords on the offbeats, gendang drums driving a 2/4 march pulse, and tambourine and maracas shaking on every beat. Bright and brisk, an open-air stage sound, the chorus wide and loud, the lead vocal forward and dry. Male lead with northern Penang Malay colour, comic and topical, half-sung and half-declaimed, and a uniformed male chorus answering in tight unison. 126 BPM, G major. Deadpan satire, marching and grinning. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no synths, no autotune, no slow ballad section, no dikir barat seated clapping.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - violin march melody and gendang roll]

[Verse 1]
Depan pasar ikan ada satu lubang besar
Hujan sikit jadi kolam, ikan keli pun boleh mandi
Isnin malam lori mai, tampal, siap pasang kon
Selasa pagi YB mai, gunting reben, ambik gambar

[Chorus]
Tampal lagi! (Tampal lagi!)
YB mai, jalan licin, YB balik, lubang mai
Tampal lagi! (Tampal lagi!)
Lubang ni lagi setia dari kucing aku

[Verse 2]
Rabu hujan turun, tar tu terkopek habis
Mak Cik Kiah naik motor, terhenjut, kangkung bertabur
Khamis malam lori mai, tampal lagi, lagi tebal
Jumaat pagi menteri mai - hang tak payah habaq, kami tau dah

[Bridge - chorus in unison with hand claps, violin stops]
Satu, dua, tiga kali dah! (Tiga kali!)
Lain kali bawa menteri tiap-tiap minggu! (Tiap-tiap minggu!)

[Chorus]
Tampal lagi! (Tampal lagi!)
YB mai, jalan licin, YB balik, lubang mai
Tampal lagi! (Tampal lagi!)
Lubang ni dah ada pangkat, kami panggil dia Datuk

[Outro - violin march to a stop, chorus shout]
Hidup lubang! (Hidup!)
Jumpa minggu depan!

tracks.title: Bukit Belakang Taman
tracks.mood: furious, grieving a hill
tracks.subject: a condominium named Bukit Permai after the hill it flattened behind the housing estate
tracks.caption: Nusantaracore, Malay heritage post-hardcore. Drop-tuned guitars playing dissonant chord stabs and tremolo lines, with a half-time breakdown before the last chorus, hardcore drums with double-kick runs and heavy floor-tom patterns, a distorted bass locked to the kick, a serunai double-reed playing a modal Malay melody over the guitars, and gendang hand drums doubling the floor toms in the intro and the breakdown. Heavy and dense, the guitars a wide wall, the serunai cutting through the middle, the clean chorus vocal forward. Male vocals, shouted rhythmic verses with clear diction delivered like recited Malay poetry, switching to a clean melodic tenor in the chorus, with screaming kept to the breakdown. 160 BPM, C# minor. Furious, grieving a hill. No autotune, no trap beats, no pop-punk bounce, no black-metal blast beats, no synths.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - gendang and serunai, then the guitars crash in]

[Verse 1 - Shouted]
Pukul tujuh pagi, jentolak dah menderum
Bukit tempat aku tangkap labah-labah masa darjah tiga
Pokok petai, pokok kerdas, sarang tebuan yang Pak Din pernah tunjuk
Satu-satu rebah, bunyi dia macam tulang patah

[Pre-Chorus - Shouted]
Papan iklan dah naik: "Hidup Hijau, Tiga Bilik"
Hijau mana? Hijau mana?

[Chorus - Clean]
Bukit belakang taman, aku tak sempat ucap selamat tinggal
Tanah merah turun ke longkang, sampai ke pintu pagar kami
Malam ni tak ada cengkerik, tak ada bunyi apa-apa
Cuma lampu kren berkelip atas tempat kami main

[Verse 2 - Shouted]
Monyet turun cari makan, selongkar tong sampah depan surau
Orang taman marah monyet, tak ada siapa marah jentolak
Aku simpan satu batu dari puncak dalam poket seluar
Batu ni lagi tua dari kita semua, sekarang dia pun tak ada rumah

[Bridge - half-time breakdown, screamed]
Ratakan! Ratakan! Ratakan semua!
Lepas tu jual balik pada kami, letak nama "Bukit"

[Chorus - Clean]
Bukit belakang taman, aku tak sempat ucap selamat tinggal
Tanah merah turun ke longkang, sampai ke pintu pagar kami
Malam ni tak ada cengkerik, tak ada bunyi apa-apa
Cuma papan tanda menyala: Residensi Bukit Permai

[Outro - serunai alone over guitar feedback]
Bukit tu dah tak ada
Nama dia masih ada
