tracks.title: 猴山仔 Kâu-san-á
tracks.mood: starving, furious and half laughing at itself
tracks.subject: a macaque on Kaohsiung's Chaishan snatching your pork-chop lunchbox before the first bite
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien melodic punk, a three-chord festival punk anthem. Two overdriven electric guitars down-picking eighth-note power chords, palm-muted in the verses and open and ringing in the choruses, with one single-note melodic lead guitar hook in the intro; electric bass locked to root eighths with the kick; drums in a straight two-and-four rock beat in the verses that switches to a double-time skate-punk beat in the choruses, with crash-ride wash and short snare-roll fills into each chorus. Live-room sound, dry and loud, guitars wide and the lead vocal forward and unprocessed. Raw shouted-sung male chest voice with clear Taigi diction, and the whole band shouting the chorus lines together as a gang vocal. 178 BPM, E major. Starving, furious and half laughing at itself. No guitar solo, no blues bends, no surf-rock reverb, no synth, no autotune, no enka-style weeping, no slow ballad breakdown.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
禮拜日 蹈柴山 規身軀汗
半山腰 坐落來 便當掀開
排骨飯 加一粒滷卵
箸 猶未提起來

[Pre-Chorus]
樹仔頂 一个影 跳落來
我的排骨 已經佇伊的手內

[Chorus]
猴山仔!猴山仔!你轉來!
彼塊排骨 我等規早起
猴山仔!猴山仔!你敢有咧看
我徛佇山路 大聲喝

[Verse]
伊坐佇樹椏 一喙一喙
滷卵 擲落來 輾到我的跤
牌仔寫 莫飼猴山仔
我無飼 是伊家己提

[Chorus]
猴山仔!猴山仔!你轉來!
彼塊排骨 賰一枝骨頭
猴山仔!猴山仔!你敢有咧看
我共白飯食甲清氣溜溜

[Outro]
伊佇樹頂 金金咧看我
下擺 我欲紮兩个便當

tracks.title: 跋桮 Pua̍h-pue
tracks.mood: stubborn fury that ends in a grin
tracks.subject: nineteen laughing divination blocks on quitting a job, then one holy block once the question becomes a three-thousand raise
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien metalcore with a nu-metal groove and temple imagery. Drop-tuned electric guitars playing syncopated chug riffs with pinch harmonics and half-time breakdowns; electric bass doubling the riff; drums in a heavy half-time groove with double-kick bursts and china-cymbal accents; a sampler layer of temple bells, one deep gong and firecracker crackle placed in the gaps between riffs. Tight, loud and modern, guitars wide, kick and snare forward, the temple sounds dry and close. Male vocal rapping the Taigi verses in a rhythmic flow, switching to hardcore screams on the shouted lines and a melodic half-clean hook in the chorus. 100 BPM, C minor in drop tuning. Stubborn fury that ends in a grin. No suona lead, no blast beats, no tremolo black-metal picking, no erhu, no trap hi-hats, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:

初一透早 三枝香 插甲直直直
我問神明 頭家遐爾歹 我敢會使辭頭路
兩塊桮 合佇手底 我共伊跋落去
兩塊 平面攏向天 笑桮

[Pre-Chorus]
笑桮!閣跋一擺!

[Chorus]
跋桮 跋桮 我跋規早起
神明 你咧笑 我嘛知
十九擺笑桮 廟公嘛咧笑
我 就毋信邪

[Verse]
我換一个問法 問較小可的
「若毋辭頭路 敢會使 加薪三千」
桮佇塗跤 輾兩輾 停落來
一爿向天 一爿覆咧

[Pre-Chorus]
聖桮!

[Chorus]
跋桮 跋桮 我跋規早起
神明 你咧笑 我嘛笑
十九擺笑桮 第二十擺 聖桮
明仔載 我去揣頭家

[Outro]
香 猶未燒了
我先來走

tracks.title: 挾尪仔 Ngeh Ang-á
tracks.mood: deadpan and smitten at one in the morning
tracks.subject: on a one a.m. claw-machine date she wins in one try the duck he fed six hundred dollars to, and hands it to him
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien 80s synth-pop in a retro Taiwanese new-wave style with home-keyboard kitsch. Juno-style analog polysynth pads holding the chords; a DX7-style FM electric piano and bell answering the vocal; a sequenced sixteenth-note synth bass; a LinnDrum-style drum machine with a gated-reverb snare and Simmons-style tom fills; a cheap home-keyboard organ playing the lead riff between lines, with chorus-drenched clean electric guitar on the offbeats. Straight eighths, no swing. A bright, dry and punchy 1980s mix, drum machine and synth bass forward, pads wide. Dry, deadpan male lead with laid-back swagger, the chorus sung in octave-doubled unison. 118 BPM, F major. Deadpan and smitten at one in the morning. No slap bass, no horn section, no jazz chords, no vocoder, no autotune, no modern EDM drop, no synthwave arpeggios.

tracks.subject: the bride's mother seating thirty banquet tables around two aunts who have not spoken in twenty years
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien musical-theatre show tune, a book-musical character number. A pit band of piano, string quartet, clarinet and flute obbligatos and acoustic bass, with a drum kit that moves from brushes to sticks, and timpani rolls and orchestral stabs marking each section turn. A rubato piano intro, a driving uptempo middle and a half-step key change into the final chorus. A roomy stage-pit sound, the voice forward and the strings wide. Female lead in a confident Broadway-style chest-mix belt, singing in character, with half-spoken recitative lines in the first verse and the bridge, and a full mixed ensemble entering in harmony on the last chorus. 132 BPM, B flat major rising to B major. Frazzled, bossy and finally triumphant. No pop drum loop, no rock guitar, no Taiwanese opera percussion or singing, no autotune, no enka-style weeping.

tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien cha-cha-chá in the Cuban charanga style. A wooden flute playing the melody hook between lines; a small violin section playing short unison riffs; piano playing a syncopated montuno; congas, timbales, guiro and cowbell keeping a straight cha-cha groove with the cha-cha-cha accent falling on four-and-one; a bass line in a tumbao-style one, two-and pattern. Bright and roomy, a small dance-band sound with the percussion and flute forward. Warm, smiling older male lead with light vibrato, and a small group answering on the written cha-cha-cha lines. 122 BPM, G major. Cocky, sleepy and laughing at one in the morning. No swing feel, no electronic organ, no nakasi keyboard, no reggaeton dembow, no Latin pop, no big-band horn section, no accordion, no trap drums, no autotune, no enka-style weeping.

tracks.title: 火金蛄 Hué-kim-koo
tracks.mood: shy, warm, a first date in the dark
tracks.subject: a first date on an unlit mountain road in April, switching the torch off to wait for the fireflies
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien dream pop. Offset-style electric guitars through chorus, long shimmer reverb and reverse delay, with slow e-bow swells; a Solina-style string-machine pad holding long chords; bass sustaining long roots with an occasional high melodic note; soft roomy drums of rim clicks, brushes and a gentle tambourine. Everything sits in a soft reverb wash, wide and warm, with the vocal set slightly inside the mix rather than on top. Breathy, airy female head voice, double-tracked, stretching the Taigi vowels over long notes. 84 BPM, D major. Shy, warm, a first date in the dark. No trap beat, no EDM drop, no acoustic folk strumming, no piano ballad, no shoegaze distortion wall, no autotune, no enka-style weeping.

tracks.title: 虼蚻 Ka-tsua̍h
tracks.mood: absurdly heroic about one cockroach
tracks.subject: the one family member sent into the kitchen at ten at night to face a flying cockroach with a can of insect spray
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien anime-opening J-rock anthem with J-pop harmony. Bright overdriven rhythm guitar under clean arpeggiated single-coil lead lines; piano doubling the main hook; synth strings and synth brass layered on the chorus; electric bass running eighth notes with fills; drums with sixteenth-note hi-hats, a four-on-the-floor kick in the pre-chorus and a driving eight-beat chorus with a crash on every bar, never a two-beat punk feel. IV-V-iii-vi progressions and a half-step key change into the last chorus. Polished, wide and dense, the lead vocal forward over the band. High clear male tenor belting long held notes with anime-opening intensity, hopeful and driving. 176 BPM, D major rising to E flat major. Absurdly heroic about one cockroach in the kitchen. No punk gang shouts, no blues guitar, no guitar solo, no trap drums, no autotune, no enka-style weeping.

tracks.title: 放送頭 Hòng-sàng-thâu
tracks.mood: gossipy, deadpan and delighted
tracks.subject: a neighbourhood chief who forgets to switch off the loudspeaker while his wife finds his secret stash
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien liam-kua, the traditional street-corner narrative song. A gekkin moon lute plucking a bright, loose pentatonic accompaniment with short fills between lines, and a daguangxian large bowed fiddle with a coconut-shell body shadowing the voice in heterophony, and nothing else. A loose pulse that stretches at the end of each four-line stanza. Dry, close and intimate, like two players on stools at a temple-front corner, the voice forward with the two instruments on either side. An older female storyteller, half-sung and half-spoken, in rhymed four-line seven-syllable stanzas, with spoken asides delivered in dry deadpan humour. 76 BPM, D pentatonic. Gossipy, deadpan and delighted. No drums, no opera gongs or cymbals, no gezaixi falsetto, no Chinese orchestra, no guitar, no synth, no jazz harmony, no rap, no enka-style weeping.

tracks.title: เซ็นตรงนี้ (Initial Here)
tracks.mood: quietly scared and sure, one page at a time
tracks.subject: a couple initialling all forty pages of their first condo loan at a Saturday bank branch while the officer reads each clause and both do the thirty-year sums in silence
tracks.caption: Thai mainstream pop ballad duet in the major-label OST style. Grand piano arpeggios and soft block chords carrying the intro and first verse, a strummed steel-string acoustic guitar entering in the second verse, a legato string section with a cello counter-line rising from the pre-chorus, drums growing from rim-click and soft kick to a full kit with a big plate-reverb snare in the chorus, a round sustained electric bass under the chords; the last chorus lifts up a half step. Intimate and close at the start, opening wide and full once the strings arrive, both voices forward and clear. A male lead and a female lead each take a verse, then sing the chorus in unison before splitting into parallel thirds, belting at the climax and breathy at the ends of lines, plain natural Thai. 72 BPM, E flat major. Quietly scared and sure, one page at a time. No trap drums, no rap, no autotune, no EDM drop, no lo-fi texture.

tracks.subject: a rainy-season night catching frogs in the paddy by headlamp with old schoolfriends home from Bangkok for one weekend, then grilling the catch at a field hut at midnight
tracks.caption: Isan indie guitar ballad in the current northeastern indie style, sung in Isan dialect. A clean electric guitar through chorus and spring reverb playing a slow arpeggio on an Isan pentatonic scale and answering the end of each vocal line with a short bent lick in the phin idiom, a strummed steel-string acoustic guitar underneath, simple live drums with soft kick and rim-click in the verses and a gentle backbeat in the chorus, a warm fingered bass and a low organ pad, a short phin-idiom guitar solo after the second chorus. tracks.title: หอกระจายข่าว (Village Speaker)
tracks.genre: Isan luk thung hook x hip-hop crossover
tracks.mood: cheeky, flirty and caught out
tracks.subject: a young man inventing lost-property reports so the girl who reads the village loudspeaker announcements will say his name
tracks.caption: Isan-indie and hip-hop crossover with a luk thung diva hook, boom-bap rather than trap. Programmed hip-hop drums with a punchy dusty kick, a crisp snare on 2 and 4 and swung sixteenth-note hi-hats with no rolls; a looped clean electric guitar figure through spring reverb in the Isan-indie style; mellow electric piano chords; a round sub-bass following the root; the beat drops out to the guitar loop alone under the first line of each hook. Dry and close with the drums forward, the guitar loop wide, the sub heavy but clean. Male rapper in Central Thai, relaxed and conversational on the verses, sliding into a melodic sung bridge; female luk thung singer with a bright, nasal-edged tone and quick lukkhor ornaments on held notes, singing the hook in Isan dialect. 92 BPM, D minor. Cheeky, flirty and caught out. No trap hi-hat rolls or triplets, no sliding 808 glides, no khaen drone, no autotune, no EDM drop, no brass band.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - clean guitar loop and one sub-bass hit]

[Verse 1 - Male rap]
ทุกเย็นห้าโมงครึ่ง ลำโพงบนเสาไฟเริ่มดัง
เสียงเธอประกาศว่าพรุ่งนี้บ่ายสามน้ำประปาไม่ไหล
ผมนั่งอยู่หน้าร้านซ่อมรถ ตั้งใจฟังทุกคำ
คิดทั้งคืนว่าทำยังไง ให้เธอเรียกชื่อผมสักครั้ง
เช้ามาผมเดินไปบ้านผู้ใหญ่ บอกว่าควายผมหาย
ควายผมไม่มีหรอก แต่ผมมีชื่อกับเบอร์โทร

[Chorus - Female, luk thung vocal]
ประกาศ ประกาศ อ้ายต้นแจ้งมาว่าควายหายเด้อ
ควายสีเทา เขาโค้ง ใส่กระดิ่งที่คอ
ผู้ได๋พบเห็น โทรหาอ้ายเอาเด้อ
แต่น้องฮู้ อ้ายบ่เคยมีควายจักโต

[Verse 2 - Male rap]
อาทิตย์ต่อมาผมแจ้งว่าหมวกกันน็อกหาย
อาทิตย์ถัดไปเป็นไก่ชน แล้วก็รองเท้าแตะข้างซ้าย
ทั้งหมู่บ้านเริ่มรู้ ป้าร้านชำแซวทุกเช้า
ไอ้หนุ่ม วันนี้อะไรหายอีก หรือว่าใจหาย
ผมยิ้มแห้ง ๆ จ่ายค่ากาแฟกระป๋อง
แต่ห้าโมงครึ่งผมยังนั่งรอเสียงเธออยู่ดี

[Chorus - Female, luk thung vocal]
ประกาศ ประกาศ อ้ายต้นแจ้งหมวกกันน็อกหายเด้อ
หมวกสีดำ มีสติกเกอร์รูปหมา
ผู้ได๋พบเห็น โทรหาอ้ายเอาเด้อ
แต่น้องเห็น หมวกอ้ายอยู่บนหัวอ้ายนั่นแหล่ว

[Bridge - melodic rap, drums drop to kick only]
ถ้าผมแจ้งว่าใจผมหาย เธอจะอ่านให้ไหม
ผมจะยืนฟังอยู่ใต้เสาไฟ จนเธอพูดจบ

[Outro - Female, over the guitar loop]
ประกาศ ประกาศ ผู้ใหญ่บ้านฝากมาบอก
อ้ายบ่ต้องแจ้งหยังอีกแล้ว วันเสาร์น้องว่างเด้อ

tracks.title: 25 องศา (Room Temp)
tracks.mood: smug, sleepy and in love
tracks.subject: a couple's nightly fight over the air-conditioner remote that always ends at twenty-five degrees
tracks.caption: Thai R&B slow jam with a half-time feel. A Rhodes electric piano with slow tremolo carrying extended seventh and ninth chords, a deep 808 sub bass sustained under each chord change, finger snaps on 2 and 4 with sparse swung hi-hats, short muted electric guitar licks between vocal lines, a reversed-reverb swell leading into each chorus. Dry and intimate with a warm low end, the lead vocal close and forward, stacked self-harmonies spread wide on the chorus instead of strings. Smooth male tenor, close-mic, with melismatic runs at line ends and a breathy falsetto on the hook. 70 BPM, A flat major. Smug, sleepy and in love. No trap hi-hat rolls, no autotune, no rap verse, no string section, no vinyl crackle, no EDM build.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - tremolo Rhodes and finger snaps]

[Verse 1]
เธอกดยี่สิบสอง พอเธอหันไปผมกดยี่สิบเจ็ด
รีโมตแอร์อยู่ใต้หมอนเธอ เหมือนของมีค่า
สี่ปีแล้วนะ เรายังเล่นเกมนี้ทุกคืน
เสียงปี๊บ ปี๊บ ในความมืด เหมือนรหัสลับของเรา

[Chorus]
ยี่สิบห้าองศา
ตัวเลขที่เราตกลงกันได้

เธอหลับไปแล้ว แต่รีโมตยังอยู่ในมือ

ผมไม่ได้หนาวจริงหรอก
ผมแค่อยากให้เธอขยับเข้ามา

[Chorus]
ยี่สิบห้าองศา
ตัวเลขที่เราตกลงกันได้
เธอดึงผ้าห่มไปทั้งผืน

ปี๊บ ยี่สิบห้า

tracks.title: ผ้าเช็ดตัวผืนเดียว (One Towel)
tracks.mood: indignant, petty and gleeful
tracks.subject: a condo management notice fining you five hundred baht for one towel drying on the balcony
tracks.caption: Thai pop-punk with an emo-style half-time breakdown. Two distorted electric guitars playing down-stroked power chords, palm-muted in the verses and ringing open in the chorus, with octave-chord lead lines between vocal phrases; a picked bass doubling the roots in driving eighth notes; a punk skate beat with crashes on every bar in the chorus and a half-time breakdown before the last chorus. Tight and loud, guitars hard left and right, the vocal up front, a short room reverb. Male lead with a raspy, slightly nasal shout-singing voice and a sarcastic edge, gang vocals shouting the answers written in the lyrics. 172 BPM, E major. Indignant, petty and gleeful. No trap 808, no autotune, no synth pads, no piano ballad section, no screamed metal vocals.

tracks.title: ลุงชิตถูกหวย (Uncle Chit Won)
tracks.mood: rowdy, broke and very happy about it
tracks.subject: a neighbour who wins two thousand baht on the lottery and hires a five-thousand-baht brass band to parade it round the soi
tracks.caption: Thai sam-cha dance in the street brass band procession style. Trumpets, trombone and alto saxophone playing short unison stab riffs, a sousaphone pumping the bass line, a big bass drum and snare playing the cha-cha-cha accent pattern, ching and chap cymbals on the off-beats, and a breakdown where the band drops to big bass drum and shouted calls before the last chorus. Loud and open like a street parade, brass forward and wide, drums punchy, very little studio polish. Male lead singing natural Thai with a luk thung edge and some grit, a group shouting back the answers written in the lyrics, an MC calling out in the break. 136 BPM, B flat major. Rowdy, broke and very happy about it. No four-on-the-floor club kick, no EDM build or supersaw, no khaen, no phin, no trap drums, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - brass stab riff and big bass drum]

[Verse 1]
บ่ายวันที่สิบหก ลุงชิตวิ่งออกมาจากบ้าน
ถือล็อตเตอรี่ไว้ในมือ ผ้าขาวม้าหลุดไปครึ่งผืน
ถูกเลขท้ายสองตัว สามสิบเจ็ด
สองพันบาทถ้วน ทั้งซอยได้ยินพร้อมกัน

[Pre-Chorus]
เย็นนั้นรถกระบะเลี้ยวเข้ามาในซอย
แตรวงสิบสองคน ค่าจ้างห้าพัน

[Chorus]
ลุงชิตถูกหวย (ถูกหวย!)
ได้มาสองพัน ค่าวงห้าพัน
เต้นผ่านหน้าบ้านใคร คนนั้นก็เต้นตาม (สามช่า!)
ขาดทุนสามพัน แต่ลุงไม่เคยเต้นเก่งขนาดนี้

[Verse 2]
ป้าแดงวิ่งออกมาถือขันน้ำ นึกว่าสงกรานต์
หมาวัดวิ่งนำขบวน เด็ก ๆ ตีกะละมังตาม
ลุงชิตใส่แว่นดำ ยกมือไหว้ทุกบ้าน
เหมือนพระเอกลิเก กลับมาเยี่ยมบ้านเกิด

[Bridge - breakdown, MC calls and band answers]
ซ้ายที ขวาที (เอ้า!)
ใครถูกหวยยกมือขึ้น (ลุงชิตคนเดียว!)

[Chorus]
ลุงชิตถูกหวย (ถูกหวย!)
ได้มาสองพัน ค่าวงห้าพัน
เต้นยาวไปจนถึงปากซอย (สามช่า!)
ลุงบอกงวดหน้าถ้าถูกอีก จะจ้างสองวง

[Outro - brass fanfare and big drum hits]
ลุงชิต ลุงชิต
ค่าแตรวงยังค้างอีกสามพันนะลุง

[Song ends abruptly]

tracks.title: นกหวีดเรือด่วน (Boat Whistle)
tracks.mood: unhurried and proud of a small skill
tracks.subject: a Chao Phraya express boat deckhand who has brought the boat into every pier with a whistle for fifteen years
tracks.caption: Thai roots reggae with a lovers rock warmth. One-drop drums with the kick and a cross-stick rimshot together on beat three, muted electric guitar chops on 2 and 4, a Hammond-style organ bubble shuffle, a deep round melodic bass line at the front of the mix, a trumpet, tenor sax and trombone section answering the vocal lines and taking a short break before the last chorus. Warm and roomy like a live band in one room, bass and drums forward, horns spread wide. Male lead with a relaxed, warm, soulful croon phrased behind the beat, soft backing harmonies on the hook. 74 BPM, G major. Unhurried and proud of a small skill. No dancehall digital riddim, no reggaeton dembow beat, no pop-reggae ukulele, no trap drums, no autotune, no EDM, no khaen.

tracks.title: หมูกระทะวันจันทร์ (Monday Diet)
tracks.mood: self-mocking and cheerful
tracks.subject: starting a diet every Monday morning and abandoning it at the Monday-night moo kratha grill
tracks.caption: Thai neo-soul band pop played by a live seven-piece band. A clean chorused rhythm guitar and a second guitar picking single-note fills, Rhodes keys comping in syncopated stabs on extended ninth chords, a warm analog mono-synth lead doubling the hook, a melodic fingered bass line that moves under every chord, laid-back live drums sitting slightly behind the beat with ghost-note snare and open hi-hat lifts into each chorus, finger snaps with the bass when the band drops out in the bridge, and a short synth solo before the last chorus. Warm live-room sound, the band spread wide, bass and vocal forward. Male tenor lead, smooth and light with a playful tone and easy falsetto lifts, the band singing harmonies on the hook lines. 104 BPM, F major. Self-mocking and cheerful. No synth-pop arpeggiators, no four-on-the-floor disco kick, no trap drums, no autotune, no rap verse, no EDM drop, no string section.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes stabs and ghost-note drums]

[Verse 1]
จันทร์เช้าผมโหลดแอปนับแคลอรี
ขึ้นตาชั่งแล้วถ่ายรูปไว้เป็นหลักฐาน
อกไก่ต้มกับไข่ขาวสองฟอง
เล่าให้ทั้งออฟฟิศฟังว่ารอบนี้เอาจริง

[Pre-Chorus]
ห้าโมงเย็น กลุ่มไลน์เด้งขึ้นมา
ร้านเดิม ซอยเดิม สองร้อยสิบเก้าบาท

[Chorus]
หมูกระทะวันจันทร์
ไดเอทผมอยู่ได้ถึงห้าโมงครึ่ง
มันหมูก้อนแรกละลายบนเตา
ผมบอกตัวเองว่าเริ่มวันอังคารก็ได้

[Verse 2]
ผมสั่งน้ำเปล่า เพื่อนทุกคนปรบมือ
แล้วผมก็ซดน้ำซุปกับวุ้นเส้นจนเกลี้ยงขอบกระทะ
ใครย่างหมูเกินก็ส่งมาที่จานผม
ผมไม่ได้อยากกินนะ ผมแค่ไม่อยากให้เสียของ

[Bridge - synth solo, then bass and snaps only]
ปีนี้ผมเริ่มไดเอทไปสี่สิบเอ็ดรอบ
ร้านหมูกระทะจำชื่อผมได้แล้ว

[Chorus]
หมูกระทะวันจันทร์
ไดเอทผมอยู่ได้ถึงห้าโมงครึ่ง
มันหมูก้อนที่สองละลายบนเตา
อังคารหน้านะ อังคารหน้าแน่นอน

[Outro - band vamp, then one Rhodes chord]
ขอน้ำจิ้มเพิ่มอีกถ้วยครับ
เผ็ดน้อยนะ ผมไดเอทอยู่

tracks.title: ประตูเงินประตูทอง (Silver Gate, Gold Gate)
tracks.mood: quick, cheeky and haggling
tracks.subject: the bride's cousins and the groom's friends bargaining in rhyme at the silver and gold door-gates of a Thai wedding
tracks.caption: Central Thai phleng i-saew folk repartee in a light modern arrangement. Ching and krap wooden clappers keeping a brisk cycle, group hand claps on the off-beats, a light drum kit played with brushes, a plucked electric bass following the claps, and a short ranat xylophone phrase between verses. Dry and close, percussion forward and narrow, the voices loud and present like a live courtyard crowd. A fast, witty male lead and a fast, sharp female lead trading rhyming verses in rapid natural Central Thai, with a group shouting the chorus tags written in the lyrics. 128 BPM, C major. Quick, cheeky and haggling. No chord pads, no string section, no trap drums, no autotune, no luk thung brass.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - ching, krap and hand claps]

[Verse 1 - Male, groom's friend]
ประตูเงินกั้นไว้ สาว ๆ ยืนขวาง
เจ้าบ่าวเหงื่อท่วมหลัง ยังไม่ทันได้ย่าง
ซองแดงละร้อย พี่มีห้าซองมาวาง
น้องคนสวยช่วยหน่อย เปิดให้พี่ผ่านทาง

[Chorus - Group shouts]
ประตูเงิน ประตูทอง
ใครจะผ่าน ต้องมีของ
ซองบาง ๆ อย่ามาลอง
เอ้า ชะ ชะ ชะ ยังไม่ผ่าน

[Verse 2 - Female, bride's cousin]
ห้าร้อยหรือพี่ ไม่พอค่าแต่งหน้า
เงินไม่ถึง เอาแรงมาแลกนะพี่จ๋า
ให้เจ้าบ่าววิดพื้นยี่สิบที ต่อหน้าแม่ยายกับป้า
แล้วตะโกนว่ากลัวเมีย ให้ทั้งซอยได้ยินถ้วนหน้า

[Verse 3 - Male, groom's friend]
วิดไปได้สิบเจ็ด เจ้าบ่าวหน้าแดงก่ำ
ราชปะแตนปริตรงรักแร้ ช่างภาพถ่ายซ้ำ
เพื่อนเจ้าบ่าวยอมแพ้ ควักกระเป๋าไม่พูดพร่ำ
สามพันสองร้อยยี่สิบ กับเหรียญอีกกำ

[Chorus - Group shouts]
ประตูเงิน ประตูทอง
ใครจะผ่าน ต้องมีของ
เหรียญบาทเต็มกำ ก็เอามาลอง
เอ้า ชะ ชะ ชะ ผ่านไปหนึ่ง

[Bridge - Male line, then Female line, claps only]
เปิดแล้วใช่ไหม เจ้าบ่าวขาสั่นแล้วนะน้อง
ใจเย็นนะพี่ ยังเหลืออีกประตูทอง

[Outro - Group shouts, ching stops]
กลัวเมีย! กลัวเมีย!
ทั้งซอยได้ยินแล้วนะเจ้าบ่าว

[Song ends abruptly]

tracks.title: ถือสายไว้ก่อน (Keep Him Talking)
tracks.mood: furious, then smug
tracks.subject: keeping a call-centre scammer pretending to be the police on the line for forty minutes at one in the morning
tracks.caption: Thai nu-metal and metalcore. Drop-C tuned guitars chugging syncopated palm-muted riffs, a breakdown with double-kick bass drum and choked crashes, a distorted bass locked tight to the kick, and a clean melodic lead guitar line over the sung chorus. Tight and heavy, guitars wide and loud, kick and snare punchy, almost no reverb on the verses and a bigger room on the chorus. Male lead rap-screaming the verses in rhythm with the riff, then switching to a clean, open melodic sung chorus in Thai. 140 BPM, C minor. Furious, then smug. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no pop synths, no EDM drop, no piano ballad section.

tracks.title: ngủ vỉa hè Hùng Vương
tracks.mood: proud and warm among strangers
tracks.subject: camping overnight on a Hanoi pavement with strangers to watch the National Day parade rehearsal
tracks.caption: Vietnamese new-generation patriotic anthem pop in the National Day singalong style. A grand piano opening alone with sparse octaves in the left hand, a strummed steel-string acoustic guitar under the verses, a military brass section playing a short fanfare figure into each chorus, marching snare cadence and timpani hits driving the choruses in a slow processional march feel, a string section in long swells, a dan bau monochord countermelody answering the lead between lines. Piano and voice close and dry in the verses, then brass, drums, strings and a stacked choir open up wide for a crowd-sized final chorus in the same key. Earnest male lead in plain diction, conversational in the verses and rising to a full chest-voice belt in the choruses, with choir and gang voices singing the chorus in unison. 84 BPM, D major. Proud and warm, a street full of strangers sharing one tarp. No trap drums, no EDM drop, no autotune, no diva melisma, no rap verse, no power-ballad key change.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - grand piano alone, sparse octaves]

[Verse 1]
Chín giờ tối, trải tấm bạt trên vỉa hè Hùng Vương
Bên trái là hai đứa sinh viên từ Thái Bình lên
Bên phải là ông cụ đeo huân chương, ngồi ghế nhựa
Ông bảo “cháu cứ ngủ đi, ông thức quen rồi”

[Pre-Chorus]
Ba giờ sáng, cả con phố chưa ai chịu về
Người lạ chuyền nhau chai nước, gói xôi, cục pin dự phòng

[Chorus]
Đêm nay ngủ vỉa hè Hùng Vương
Má ai cũng dán một lá cờ nhỏ
Chẳng ai quen ai mà gọi nhau “nhà mình ơi”
Sáng mai đoàn quân đi qua, mình đứng dậy hát

[Verse 2]
Năm giờ, tiếng trực thăng kéo cờ ầm ầm trên đầu
Ông cụ đứng dậy trước cả bọn tôi
Ông đứng nghiêm, cái ghế nhựa đổ ra sau lưng

metas.prompt: Vietnamese new-generation patriotic anthem pop in the National Day singalong style. A grand piano opening alone with sparse octaves in the left hand, a strummed steel-string acoustic guitar under the verses, a military brass section playing a short fanfare figure into each chorus, marching snare cadence and timpani hits driving the choruses in a slow processional march feel, a string section in long swells, a dan bau monochord countermelody answering the lead between lines. Piano and voice close and dry in the verses, then brass, drums, strings and a stacked choir open up wide for a crowd-sized final chorus in the same key. Earnest male lead in plain diction, conversational in the verses and rising to a full chest-voice belt in the choruses, with choir and gang voices singing the chorus in unison. 84 BPM, D major. tracks.title: xông đất mười bảy nhà
tracks.mood: cheerful and overbooked, sprinting between doorsteps
tracks.subject: being booked as the lucky first-footer by seventeen neighbours on the first morning of Tết because your birth year suits the new year
tracks.caption: Vietnamese Tet festive pop in the Lunar New Year family singalong style. A sao truc bamboo flute playing a bright major-pentatonic hook, lion-dance drums and cymbal crashes locked to a bouncy pop beat with handclaps, dan tranh zither glissandi on every section change, short brass stabs on the offbeats, firecracker crackle on the downbeat of each chorus. Bright, busy and close, percussion and flute forward, the bass round and simple. Playful male lead with a smiling, talky delivery, and a crowd of neighbours shouting from their doorways in call-and-response that he answers line by line. 118 BPM, G major. Cheerful and overbooked, one lucky birth year sprinting between doorsteps. No trap hi-hats, no rap verse, no autotune, no EDM drop, no ballad slowdown.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - sao truc hook, lion-dance drums, firecrackers]

[Verse 1]
Ông thầy đầu ngõ phán năm nay tuổi tôi hợp nhất phố
Từ hôm hai ba tháng Chạp, cả ngõ nhắn tin đặt lịch
Bác Cả số chín, cô Ba số mười một, ông Tư cuối ngõ
Mười bảy nhà, mà sáng mùng một tôi chỉ có hai chân

[Chorus - neighbours call, he answers]
(Tới chưa con?) Dạ, cháu đang chạy
(Chân nào trước?) Dạ, chân phải ạ
(Ngồi ăn đã!) Dạ, cháu xin hẹn tối
Chúc mừng năm mới, cháu xin phép chạy tiếp ạ!

[Verse 2]
Nhà thứ năm, lỡ bước chân trái, bà chủ bắt ra bước lại
Nhà thứ chín có con chó, tôi xông đất bằng cửa sau
Nhà mười hai, chú chủ nhà dúi chén rượu, bảo “lấy khí thế”
Tới nhà mười sáu, cả ngõ ra đứng đếm hộ tôi

[Chorus - neighbours call, he answers]
(Tới chưa con?) Dạ, cháu tới rồi
(Chân nào trước?) Dạ, chân phải, lần này chắc chắn
(Ngồi ăn đã!) Dạ, cháu xin hẹn tối
Chúc mừng năm mới, cháu xin phép chạy tiếp ạ!

[Bridge - drums drop to a single lion-dance drum]
Nhà thứ mười bảy là nhà mình, cửa vẫn khép
Mẹ đứng sau cửa nhắc “chân phải nhé con”

[Outro - full band, firecrackers, crowd shout]
Mười bảy nhà, mười bảy bước chân phải, năm nay cả ngõ phát tài!

tracks.title: phòng 302 sau bảo vệ
tracks.mood: four years of deadlines let go in one night
tracks.subject: twelve classmates in karaoke room 302 the night after defending their graduation theses
tracks.caption: Vinahouse, the Vietnamese club-remix style known as nhac san. A four-on-the-floor kick, a rolling pitched offbeat vina bassline heavily sidechained so it pumps under everything, a detuned saw lead with pitch-bend fills answering the vocal, long snare-roll risers into hard drops, air-horn hits on the drops. Loud, compressed and wide, kick and rolling bass forward, mixed for a karaoke-room speaker turned all the way up. Young male lead singing a straight V-pop melody over the beat, unprocessed, with a hype MC voice shouting the short lines in parentheses. 136 BPM, A minor. Release after four years of deadlines, everyone standing on the sofa. No chopped or resampled voices, no trap drums, no dubstep wobble, no autotune, no slow ballad section.

[Intro - short rolling vina bassline, quick snare roll]

Bốn giờ chiều bảo vệ xong, thầy gật đầu một cái

Đứa còn mặc vest, đứa còn kẹp tờ slide in sai

Mười hai đứa quẩy như chưa từng ngồi thư viện

Young male lead singing a straight V-pop melody over the beat, unprocessed, with a hype MC voice shouting the short lines in parentheses. 136 BPM, A minor. Release after four years of deadlines, everyone standing on the sofa. No chopped or resampled voices, no trap drums, no dubstep wobble, no autotune, no slow ballad section.

tracks.title: bảy cặp kính lão
tracks.genre: Trinh Cong Son urban jazz-combo revival
tracks.mood: tender and quietly amused
tracks.subject: a husband who has hidden a spare pair of his wife's reading glasses in every room of the house
tracks.caption: Trinh Cong Son-style Vietnamese song arranged for a drumless jazz trio. Nylon-string guitar comping soft chords on the off-beats, upright bass walking lightly, Rhodes electric piano with ninth and eleventh voicings, a solo cello answering the vocal in long low lines and taking a short solo between the two halves. Dry, close and narrow, like a small room with eight tables, voice and guitar forward, nothing louder than a conversation. Male baritone, low and intimate, phrasing almost spoken with little vibrato and breathy line endings, opening in slow rubato before the trio settles in. 72 BPM, E minor. Tender and quietly amused, thirty years of small kindnesses. No drum kit, no horns, no string orchestra, no autotune, no bolero rhythm, no power-ballad belting.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - nylon guitar and upright bass, short rubato]

[Verse 1]
Sáng nào em cũng hỏi “anh thấy kính em đâu không”
Ba mươi năm, câu ấy thay cho câu chào buổi sáng
Kính em cài trên tóc, mà em lục khắp cả nhà
Tôi ngồi pha ấm trà, nhìn em tìm, chẳng nỡ nói

[Pre-Chorus]
Năm ngoái tôi ra chợ Đồng Xuân, mua một lần bảy cặp
Giấu mỗi phòng một cặp, em chẳng hay

[Chorus]
Bảy cặp kính lão trong nhà
Một cặp cạnh hũ muối, một cặp dưới gối em
Em với tay chỗ nào cũng có sẵn một cặp
Em khoe dạo này em hết lẫn rồi

[Verse 2]
Hôm qua em mở tủ giày, thấy một cặp nằm trong đó
Em cầm lên, đứng nhìn tôi một lúc lâu
Em không hỏi gì, chỉ lấy vạt áo lau mắt kính
Rồi đọc to cho tôi nghe tin dự báo thời tiết

[Instrumental Break - cello solo over nylon guitar]

[Chorus]
Bảy cặp kính lão trong nhà
Một cặp cạnh hũ muối, một cặp dưới gối em
Em với tay chỗ nào cũng có sẵn một cặp
Em vẫn khoe em hết lẫn, tôi vẫn gật đầu

[Outro - cello and nylon guitar, fading]
Sáng nay tôi hỏi “em thấy kính anh đâu không”
Em chỉ vào túi áo tôi, cặp kính em để sẵn từ hôm nào

tracks.title: mười một ổ bánh mì
tracks.mood: loyal and teasing
tracks.subject: buying the last eleven bánh mì on the slow first day of a friend's new cart after she quit her bank job
tracks.caption: Vietnamese healing indie pop-rock, the live five-piece band sound from Da Nang. Clean electric guitar arpeggios drenched in chorus and plate reverb in the verses, a lightly overdriven rhythm guitar strumming in the choruses, a picked electric bass, an acoustic drum kit with open hi-hat and floor-tom builds into each chorus, piano doubling the vocal hook. Live-room sound, warm and mid-forward, guitars and drums slightly rough, nothing quantized. Earnest male tenor singing in a central Vietnamese Quang Nam-Da Nang accent, straight tone and a slightly unpolished edge, with gang oh-oh backing vocals on the chorus tags. 96 BPM, C major. Loyal and teasing, a friend buying out the cart. No synth bass, no programmed drums, no autotune, no shoegaze fuzz, no rap.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - clean chorus guitar arpeggio, then drums]

[Verse 1]
Bảy giờ sáng, xe bánh mì của mi mở hàng ngày đầu
Tấm bảng giá mi tự viết, nét chữ còn run
Mười giờ rồi, mới bán hai ổ, trên xe còn mười một
Một ổ cho chú xe ôm, một ổ cho con mèo nhà bên

[Pre-Chorus]

[Chorus]
Cho tau mười một ổ bánh mì
Thêm ớt, thêm đồ chua, ổ mô cũng đủ
Tau ăn không hết, nhưng hôm nay mi phải bán hết
Ngày đầu tiên thì chưa tính, mi nghe chưa
Oh-oh, oh-oh, mi nghe chưa

Chị trưởng phòng ăn xong hỏi “xe đó mai còn bán không em”

[Outro - guitar alone, gang vocals]
Bánh mì mi hơi khét, tau không nói đâu

tracks.title: chốt đơn lúc mười một giờ
tracks.mood: sleepless and amused
tracks.subject: a neighbour who livestreams face cream through the wall every night at eleven, and the mother who goes over to complain
tracks.caption: Vietnamese xam pop, a modern revival of northern street-busker xam singing. A dan nhi two-string fiddle sliding through the melody and answering each line, a phach bamboo clapper and a senh tien coin clapper clicking on the offbeats, trong manh small hand-drum patterns locked to a programmed pop kick and claps, a dan bau monochord bending between phrases, a round electric bass under the chorus only. Dry and close like a street corner, fiddle and clapper forward, the modern kick tucked underneath, the 2/4 market-song pulse kept throughout. Female lead in a nasal, heavily ornamented xam storytelling voice with luyen lay turns, singing six-eight verses and breaking into spoken busker banter. 104 BPM, D minor. Sleepless and amused, a neighbour roasted from the other side of the wall. No trap hi-hats, no 808, no autotune, no EDM drop, no Western ballad chords, no rap verse.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - dan nhi slide, phach clicks, kick enters]

[Verse 1]
Nhà bên có cái chị Hoa
Mười một giờ tối mở loa lên đèn
Ba mươi hũ kem xếp chen
Chị cười với máy như quen lâu rồi
Tường nhà mỏng tựa giấy thôi
Chị hô một tiếng, tôi ngồi bật dậy

[Chorus]
“Chốt đơn! Chốt đơn!” chị hô xuyên tường
“Bảy ngày trắng da, không trắng hoàn tiền”
Bên này tôi nằm đếm cừu không nổi
Đếm luôn đơn chị: ba trăm lẻ hai

[Verse 2]
Mẹ tôi sang mắng chị Hoa
Mười phút sau về, đã là khách quen
Tay cầm hai hũ, còn khen
Bảo tôi học chị, đừng ghen, mà làm

[Chorus]
“Chốt đơn! Chốt đơn!” giờ hai giọng xuyên tường
Chị hô một tiếng, mẹ tôi hô theo
Bên này tôi nằm đếm cừu không nổi
Đếm luôn đơn mẹ: mười hai, toàn họ hàng

[Bridge - spoken busker banter over dan nhi]
Thưa các cô các bác đi qua
Ai bán cho tôi một đêm ngủ yên, tôi chốt liền tay

[Outro - phach alone]
Một đêm ngủ yên, còn hàng không chị?

tracks.title: đẩy xe qua Mã Pí Lèng
tracks.mood: furious, stubborn, then laughing at himself
tracks.subject: pushing a dead motorbike six kilometres up the Mã Pí Lèng pass after dark rather than let a friend call a truck
tracks.caption: Vietnamese heritage progressive rock in the rock ngu cung style. Twin distorted electric guitars playing pentatonic northern-mountain folk riffs in harmony, a sao bamboo flute doubling the main riff, tom-heavy tribal drum patterns that switch to double-kick sections in the choruses, a Hammond organ pad under the instrumental passages, an odd-meter breakdown in 7/8 before the last chorus. Big, loud and live, guitars wide and the flute cutting through the middle. High tenor rock belt with folk ornaments on the held notes, telling the story in the verses and shouting the refrain with the band. 148 BPM, E minor. Furious and stubborn, one man pushing a dead motorbike up a mountain pass. No pop-punk, no metalcore screaming, no autotune, no trap drums, no ballad section.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short twin pentatonic guitar riff, tom-heavy drums]

[Verse 1]
Bốn giờ chiều, con Wave cũ tắt máy giữa đèo Mã Pí Lèng
Đạp cần năm chục lần, nó ho một tiếng rồi im luôn
Thằng bạn rút điện thoại gọi xe tải, tôi giật lại
Xe tôi tự chạy lên tới đây, nửa đèo còn lại tôi đẩy

[Pre-Chorus]
Sông Nho Quế dưới vực xanh như chẳng có chuyện gì
Tôi buộc áo khoác ngang hông, cúi đầu, bắt đầu đẩy

[Chorus]
Đèo còn dài thì tao còn đẩy
Sáu cây số, tao đếm từng cột mốc
Mày tắt máy thì tao còn hai cái chân
Chưa lên tới đỉnh, đừng ai gọi xe tải

[Verse 2]
Một bà cụ người Mông lùa đàn dê đi ngang, nhìn tôi cười
Ba đứa nhỏ đeo gùi chạy theo đẩy phụ một khúc
Trời tối hẳn, đèn pha xe khách quét qua lưng tôi
Bắp chân run, mà tay vẫn nắm chặt tay lái

[Bridge - 7/8 breakdown, sao doubling the riff]
Hồi nhỏ nghe chuyện Sơn Tinh, nước dâng bao nhiêu núi cao bấy nhiêu
Tối nay núi cao thêm bao nhiêu, tôi đẩy thêm bấy nhiêu

[Chorus]
Đèo còn dài thì tao còn đẩy
Cột mốc cuối cùng, tao đá cho một cái
Mày tắt máy thì tao còn hai cái chân
Lên tới đỉnh rồi, thả dốc, khỏi cần ai

[Outro - guitars ring out, drums stop]
Xuống tới Mèo Vạc, ông thợ mở bình xăng ra nhìn
“Hết xăng thôi em”, tôi ngồi bệt xuống bậc thềm mà cười

tracks.mood: flirty and in no hurry
tracks.subject: a tailor on Lê Thánh Tôn street who measures her three times because neither of them wants the fitting to end
tracks.caption: Saigon 1960s-70s nightclub jazz revival, an up-tempo swing dance-floor number. A small horn section of alto sax, tenor sax, trumpet and trombone playing riffs between the lines, a walking upright bass, swing drums driving on the ride cymbal with snare kicks, comping jazz piano under the verses, a cha-cha-cha breakdown with congas and a bluesy tenor sax solo in the middle, dan tranh zither adding short runs on the turnarounds. Acoustic and roomy like a pre-1975 Saigon club bandstand, horns bright and slightly brassy, no modern compression. Female nightclub chanteuse alto with blue-note bends and crooning legato, teasing and unhurried over the fast band, in southern Saigon pronunciation. 140 BPM, B-flat major. Flirty and in no hurry, a fitting stretched out on purpose. No synths, no slap bass, no city-pop sheen, no bolero rhythm, no autotune.

tracks.title: qua cầu Bến Thủy
tracks.mood: teasing and sweet, courting a girl and her mother at once
tracks.subject: riding across Bến Thủy bridge every Saturday to court a Hà Tĩnh girl whose mother answers everything with 'rứa à'
tracks.caption: Contemporary Nghe Tinh vi giam, a modern arrangement of the central Vietnamese call-song tradition. A free-meter opening with sao truc bamboo flute and a dan nhi two-string fiddle holding a drone under the long vi calls, then giam sections in a steady 2/4 with trong com drum and a wooden mo clapper, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft string pads and a light kick underneath. Open and airy in the vi calls, then dry and close in the giam sections, voices forward and the band small. Male and female duet in heavy Nghe Tinh dialect: long held vi calls with falling-tone ornaments, then short five-syllable giam lines declaimed in turn and together. 88 BPM after a rubato opening, A minor. Teasing and sweet, courting a girl and her mother at once. No rap, no trap drums, no autotune, no pop ballad chorus, no EDM.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short sao truc phrase over dan nhi drone]

[Verse 1 - Male, free-meter vi call]
Ơ... chiều thứ bảy eng chạy xe qua cầu Bến Thủy
Nước sông Lam xanh rứa, mà bụng eng nỏ yên

[Verse 2 - Female, vi reply]
Ơ... eng qua chi mà tuần mô cũng qua một bận
Mạ em hỏi “thằng mô rứa”, em nói “người quen thôi mạ”

[Chorus - Duet, giam in steady 2/4]
Eng qua cầu Bến Thủy
Xách theo hai nải chuối
Mạ em ngồi ngoài hiên
Mạ chỉ nói “rứa à”

[Verse 3 - Male, giam]
Eng hỏi mạ khỏe nỏ
Mạ chỉ nói “rứa à”
Eng nói eng thương o
Mạ cũng nói “rứa à”

[Verse 4 - Female, giam]
Mạ em nỏ nói nhiều
Nhưng mạ để phần eng
Một đọi cháo lươn nóng
Rứa là mạ ưng rồi

[Chorus - Duet, giam in steady 2/4]
Eng qua cầu Bến Thủy
Xách theo hai nải chuối
Mạ em ngồi ngoài hiên
Múc cho eng đọi cháo

[Outro - female vi call, free meter, then sao alone]
Ơ... thứ bảy sau eng qua, nhớ đừng mua chuối nữa
Mạ nói “rứa à”, mà mạ cười đó eng ơi

tracks.title: chờ một tiếng trống chầu
tracks.mood: nervous, then quietly proud
tracks.subject: a twenty-two-year-old's first ca trù performance and the single stroke of the praise drum she waits for
tracks.caption: Ca tru world music, northern Vietnamese chamber art song with a light modern layer. A dan day long-neck three-string lute plucked in sparse bending phrases, the singer's phach bamboo block struck with two sticks in syncopated patterns, a trong chau praise drum giving single sharp strokes on the good lines, a cello holding long low notes and a soft frame drum, faint ambient pads underneath. Intimate and roomy like a wooden communal house, lute and clapper forward, the cello far behind. Young female ca nuong in a nasal head voice with the throat-pulsed do hot vibrato, slow and elegant hat noi delivery. 66 BPM in loose rubato, D minor. Nervous, then quietly proud, one drum stroke earned. No drum kit, no pop chords, no autotune, no Western classical soprano, no EDM pulse.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short dan day phrase, two phach strokes]

[Verse 1]
Tối thứ năm, đình Kim Ngân phố Hàng Bạc
Mười hai người khách ngồi chiếu, tôi ngồi giữa
Hai dùi phách trong tay, tay tôi lạnh ngắt
Cụ Khang tám mốt tuổi cầm dùi trống, nhắm mắt

[Pre-Chorus]
Ba năm tập đổ hột trong phòng trọ
Hàng xóm cứ tưởng tôi bị nấc cụt

[Chorus]
Tôi chờ một tiếng trống chầu
Không cần cả đình vỗ tay
Chỉ cần dùi cụ gõ một tiếng “chát”
Là câu ấy tôi hát đúng rồi

[Verse 2]
Câu đầu tôi run, giọng vấp vào nhịp phách
Cụ Khang vẫn nhắm mắt, dùi trống nằm yên
Tới câu thứ năm, tôi quên mất mình đang sợ
Giọng tự rung lên, chẳng còn giống tiếng nấc

[Chorus]
Rồi tôi nghe một tiếng trống chầu
Không cần cả đình vỗ tay
Dùi cụ gõ một tiếng “chát”, mắt cụ vẫn nhắm
Cả đình im, chỉ còn tay tôi gõ phách

[Outro - dan day and phach, slowing to silence]

“Hết rồi chị ạ, tối nay em được thưởng trống”

Intimate and roomy like a wooden communal house, lute and clapper forward, the cello far behind. Young female ca nuong in a nasal head voice with the throat-pulsed do hot vibrato, slow and elegant hat noi delivery. 66 BPM in loose rubato, D minor. Nervous, then quietly proud, one drum stroke earned. No drum kit, no pop chords, no autotune, no Western classical soprano, no EDM pulse.

[Intro - short dan day phrase, two phach strokes]

[Verse 1]
Tối thứ năm, đình Kim Ngân phố Hàng Bạc
Mười hai người khách ngồi chiếu, tôi ngồi giữa
Hai dùi phách trong tay, tay tôi lạnh ngắt
Cụ Khang tám mốt tuổi cầm dùi trống, nhắm mắt

[Pre-Chorus]
Ba năm tập đổ hột trong phòng trọ
Hàng xóm cứ tưởng tôi bị nấc cụt

[Chorus]
Tôi chờ một tiếng trống chầu
Không cần cả đình vỗ tay
Chỉ cần dùi cụ gõ một tiếng “chát”
Là câu ấy tôi hát đúng rồi

[Verse 2]
Câu đầu tôi run, giọng vấp vào nhịp phách
Cụ Khang vẫn nhắm mắt, dùi trống nằm yên
Tới câu thứ năm, tôi quên mất mình đang sợ
Giọng tự rung lên, chẳng còn giống tiếng nấc

[Chorus]
Rồi tôi nghe một tiếng trống chầu
Không cần cả đình vỗ tay
Dùi cụ gõ một tiếng “chát”, mắt cụ vẫn nhắm
Cả đình im, chỉ còn tay tôi gõ phách

[Outro - dan day and phach, slowing to silence]
Về phòng trọ, chị hàng xóm hỏi “hết nấc chưa em”
“Hết rồi chị ạ, tối nay em được thưởng trống”

tracks.title: 又眨眼
tracks.mood: giggly, squashed and competitive
tracks.subject: five friends squeezed into a Mong Kok photo-sticker booth, eight poses in ten seconds a shot, and one of them blinking in every frame
tracks.caption: Cantonese idol girl-group dance-pop in the current K-pop-influenced Hong Kong style, written for choreography. A bouncy syncopated programmed kick with a dry hand clap and finger snaps left bare in the intro, a sidechained synth bass pumping under every bar, bright staccato synth plucks carrying the main riff, sixteenth-note hi-hat rolls building through the pre-chorus, a half-time dance break of stomps and layered claps before the last chorus. Tight, clean and close, wide stereo plucks, drums and voices forward. Several young female voices trading lines, bright head voice on the chorus, unison gang shouts on the count-in, one short rap verse. 124 BPM, B minor. Five friends squashed into a photo-sticker booth, giggly and competitive. No ballad section, no rock guitar, no autotune, no 80s retro synth palette, no male vocal, no supersaw EDM drop, no four-on-the-floor kick, no trap 808 slides.

tracks.title: 八號風球
tracks.mood: sudden freedom, running laughing into the rain
tracks.subject: typhoon signal number eight going up at twenty to five and a whole office building emptying at once
tracks.caption: Cantonese drum and bass pop with a radio topline. Chopped breakbeat drums with a ghost-note snare shuffle, held at half-time in the verses and doubling into full drum and bass on the chorus; a rolling sub bass with a filtered Reese layer growling underneath; an airy synth pad and bright piano stabs over the top; rain-like noise swells between sections. Polished and wide, the breaks crisp, pad and piano spread out, the lead vocal clearly forward. Clean mainstream Cantopop male lead holding long notes over the fast breaks, a second male voice rapping the half-time verse. 172 BPM, F# minor. A city let off work early and running into the rain. No trap 808 slides, no glitch effects, no autotune, no four-on-the-floor kick, no acoustic guitar.

tracks.title: 兩隻匙羹
tracks.mood: newly in love, sun-drunk and in no hurry
tracks.subject: sharing one bowl of tofu pudding with two spoons at the Lamma pier with someone you have just started seeing
tracks.caption: Cantonese Afrobeats pop with a light dancehall lean. A syncopated kick and rim-click groove, a steady shaker and conga loop, a rimshot clave, a short talking-drum fill at each turnaround; palm-muted highlife-style clean electric guitar licks weaving between the vocal lines; a warm round sub bass and a soft Rhodes. Warm and close with a laid-back off-beat groove, percussion spread wide, guitar and voice forward. Relaxed, breathy female lead in the mid register, short repeated chant hooks, soft backing harmonies on the chorus. 104 BPM, A major. Newly in love, sun-drunk and in no hurry. No four-on-the-floor kick, no amapiano log drum, no funk slap bass, no EDM drop, no autotune, no trap hi-hats.

tracks.title: 準時放工
tracks.mood: rowdy, disbelieving and triumphant
tracks.subject: five office friends putting ten dollars each on the silliest-named horse at Happy Valley on a Wednesday night and watching it come from last to first
tracks.caption: Cantonese big-room EDM pop with a festival build and drop. A snare roll and white-noise riser under a filtered pad in each build, then a hard clean drop: a bright supersaw lead stating the riff, a distorted growling bass under it, a hard four-on-the-floor kick with heavy sidechain pumping the whole mix, a crash on every drop. Big, loud and wide, kick and supersaw forward on the drop, the voice forward in the builds. Strong belted female pop lead in the verses and builds, the whole group shouting one hook word on each drop. 128 BPM, G minor. Five office friends screaming a long shot home at the races, loud and triumphant. No trap verse, no glitch effects, no retro 80s synths, no autotune, no ballad breakdown.

禮拜三 放工 跑馬地 草地仲濕
五個同事 一人一杯啤酒 企喺欄杆前面

放工！

衝呀！ 衝呀！ 準時放工！
最後一個彎 由包尾 追到第一

放工！

一人五百蚊

tracks.title: 第十格
tracks.mood: proud, playful and in love
tracks.subject: a couple in a Friday-night bowling league in Kowloon Bay where she bowls and he keeps the score sheet and shouts every strike
tracks.caption: Cantonese new jack swing in the late-80s dance R&B style. A swing-quantized sixteenth-note drum machine with a hard cracking gated snare and a swung hi-hat, synth-brass and orchestra-hit stabs on the off-beats, a rubbery synth bassline, a short bell-like FM synth hook in the intro that returns before the last chorus, a stripped drum-machine breakdown. Punchy and dry, snare and stabs forward, the bass round and centred. Agile male lead with clipped rhythmic phrasing, sung choruses, short shouted ad-libs placed for a dance routine. 106 BPM, D minor. Proud, playful and in love. No slow-jam ballad, no neo-soul Rhodes, no live horn section, no straight unswung beat, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap chorus, no acoustic guitar.

tracks.title: 前面有落
tracks.mood: a comic standoff that turns into a singalong
tracks.subject: a passenger who calls her minibus stop two traffic lights too late, and all sixteen passengers taking sides
tracks.caption: Cantonese original musical theatre, a comic ensemble number from a book musical. A theatre pit orchestra: a driving piano conductor part, pizzicato strings turning to bowed strings, a clarinet and bassoon answering the singers, bright brass punctuation on the jokes, timpani and a snare roll on every stop. The orchestra stops and restarts with the action, slowing for a short solo section and then returning faster. Roomy and stage-like, voices dry and forward, orchestra spread wide behind. A female character voice moving from spoken lines into a full belt, a gruff male driver character answering her, and a full ensemble chorus as the other passengers, clear diction with every word on a note. 112 BPM, Bb major. A comic standoff that turns into a singalong. No pop drum kit, no synths, no autotune, no rock guitar, no rap.

tracks.title: 廿四味
tracks.mood: wry, warm storytelling
tracks.subject: a herbal tea shop owner who looks at your tongue and tells you exactly how late you stayed up
tracks.caption: Naamyam, the Cantonese narrative song tradition of the blind street storytellers, sung as a tale about a neighbourhood character. A yehu coconut-shell fiddle leading with a nasal, sliding line and a short lead-in before the voice, a guzheng zither plucking sparse answering phrases, a dongxiao vertical bamboo flute holding long low notes between verses, a single wooden clapper marking the end of each couplet. Sparse and intimate, close like a teahouse corner, the voice dry and clearly forward. Solo male storyteller voice, half-sung and half-spoken, with lingering melismatic cadences at the end of each line. 60 BPM, D major, flexible and rubato. Wry, warm storytelling. No drum kit, no pop chords, no synths, no Western strings, no autotune, no Cantonese opera gongs and cymbals, no operatic falsetto.

tracks.title: 三十一、三十二
tracks.mood: patient, funny and quietly proud
tracks.subject: a retired schoolteacher on the Sai Kung pier teaching himself to cast from a phone video every Sunday, counting every cast out loud
tracks.caption: Hong Kong math-folk in the math rock lineage. A fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar playing bright interlocking arpeggios against a clean electric guitar two-hand tapping and answering with chimed harmonics; a busy melodic electric bass running counter-lines; crisp dry drums with tight hi-hat work and stop-start accents; a light synth pad entering only in the last chorus. Odd and shifting meters, 7/8 verses opening into 4/4 choruses. Dry, close and small-room, guitars panned left and right, voice soft and centred. Soft, unforced female lead, conversational and slightly detached, with gentle harmonies on the chorus, Cantonese with a few English words. 132 BPM, E major. Patient, funny and quietly proud. No distorted power chords, no straight four-on-the-floor, no autotune, no trap drums, no strummed acoustic chords.

tracks.title: 打橫行
tracks.mood: furious, sardonic and danceable
tracks.subject: being stuck at lunch behind five people walking abreast on a Causeway Bay pavement while the cha chaan teng queue grows
tracks.caption: Cantonese electro post-punk played by a live band. Driving motorik live drums with a metronomic floor tom pulse, a repeating overdriven bass riff that never leaves the root, an angular trebly electric guitar scratching short off-beat figures, a lo-fi synth riff looping like a pedestrian-crossing beeper. Raw and dry, mid-heavy, bass and drums forward, a little reverb on the guitar only. Shouted, sardonic male delivery in Hong Kong street slang in the verses, half-chanted gang choruses with sing-song Cantonese bends on the line endings. 148 BPM, E minor. Furious, sardonic and danceable. No melodic rock ballad chorus, no trap drums, no autotune, no EDM drop, no acoustic guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
一點零五 銅鑼灣 我得四十分鐘食飯
前面五個人 一字排開 打橫行
一個睇地圖 一個影相 一個停低睇鞋
成條行人路 冇一條罅

[Pre-Chorus]
我閃左 佢哋又移左
我閃右 佢哋又移右

[Chorus]
打橫行！ 打橫行！
五個人 霸晒成條行人路
我數住 一步 兩步 又蝕咗十步
茶記門口 條隊又長咗一截

[Verse]
隔籬架叮叮 行得仲快過我
過馬路「嘟嘟嘟」 佢哋企喺中間再影多張
我想講「唔該借借」 把聲畀巴士食咗
四十分鐘 淨返廿二

[Chorus]
打橫行！ 打橫行！
五個人 霸晒成條行人路
我數住 一步 兩步 又蝕咗十步
行到茶記 佢哋五個 坐咗最後一張枱

[Outro]
我企喺門口
「唔該 外賣 餐蛋麵」

tracks.title: 佔兩個位
tracks.mood: deadpan, tired and quietly delighted
tracks.subject: carrying a second-hand Carousell keyboard home across two seats of a 2 a.m. night bus while a drunk passenger asks for a song
tracks.caption: Hong Kong twee indie pop with a lo-fi home-recording feel. A cheap home keyboard playing simple bouncy chords with a slightly wobbly tone, a nylon-string guitar strumming light bossa-tinged chords, a basic drum-machine pattern with a soft brushed snare, a melodica taking the short solo and a glockenspiel doubling the chorus melody. Short, dry and plain, small-room and narrow, the voice and keyboard forward. Sweet, untrained, breathy female lead, almost spoken, quoting the other passengers' lines in a flatter deadpan tone. 100 BPM, F major. Tired, amused and quietly delighted. No big drums, no electric guitar solo, no autotune, no orchestral strings, no stadium reverb.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
Carousell三百蚊 一部二手電子琴
賣家喺葵芳 約我凌晨一點半
抬唔上上層 坐喺下層最尾
佢佔咗兩個位 我坐喺佢隔籬

[Pre-Chorus]
每次轉彎 我就扶實佢
好似扶住一個 飲醉咗嘅朋友

[Chorus]
凌晨兩點 通宵巴士
一部琴 佔咗兩個位
有人想瞓覺 有人想返屋企
我淨係想 佢唔好跌落地

[Verse]
真係飲醉咗嗰個阿叔 行過嚟坐低
佢話「靚女 彈首嚟聽吓」
我話「佢入咗六粒電芯 唔知仲有冇電」
一撳落去 佢自己彈起首生日歌

[Chorus]
凌晨兩點 通宵巴士
一部琴 佔咗兩個位
阿叔跟住唱 我跟住彈
司機 收細咗佢部收音機

[Outro]
落車嗰陣 阿叔同我講
「下次 彈首新啲嘅」

tracks.title: 我們贏了一場欸
tracks.mood: losers for three seasons, champions for one night
tracks.subject: an office basketball team winning its first game in three seasons on two free throws from the accountant
tracks.caption: Taiwanese stadium band pop-rock in the Mayday and 831 arena style. Two overdriven electric guitars, one chugging eighth-note power chords and one ringing chorus-pedal arpeggios; a picked bass locked to the kick; a live drum kit with a big room-miked snare on two and four, crashes on every chorus downbeat and floor-tom rolls into the chorus; a piano doubling the chorus melody, with a string pad entering in the last chorus. Big and roomy with wide guitars, the lead vocal and the snare forward, the bridge dropping to half-time. Earnest bright male lead in the mid-high range, almost spoken in the verses and belting open vowels in the chorus, with a crowd-style gang vocal singing whoa-oh in the bridge. 148 BPM, E major. Office workers who just won one game and feel like champions. No synth bass, no programmed drums, no autotune, no rap verse, no screamed vocals.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - power-chord chug, ringing chorus guitar, floor-tom roll]

[Verse 1]
三個球季 我們一場都沒贏過
球衣是運動會剩下的 背號用膠帶貼
會計投籃之前 一定要先推一下眼鏡
替補的工程師 坐在板凳上回客戶的信

[Pre-Chorus]
剩四秒 我們輸一分
球不知道為什麼 傳到了會計手上

[Chorus]
我們贏了一場欸
罰球線上那個推眼鏡的人 兩球都進
沒有記者 沒有轉播 只有看門的伯伯在打瞌睡
可是我們抱成一團 好像拿了冠軍

[Verse 2]
對面是銀行隊 上禮拜還在笑我們
我們的啦啦隊 是會計的女兒跟她的平板
贏了也沒有獎盃 體育館的燈九點半準時關
我們在停車場 用寶特瓶乾杯

[Chorus]
我們贏了一場欸
罰球線上那個推眼鏡的人 兩球都進
明天開會一樣會被罵 報表一樣要交
可是今天晚上 我們是整個停車場最大聲的

[Bridge - half-time, gang vocals]
喔 喔喔 喔 我們贏了一場
喔 喔喔 喔 下禮拜再輸也沒關係

[Chorus - full band, string pad enters]
我們贏了一場欸
罰球線上那個推眼鏡的人 兩球都進
三個球季 才等到這一場
今天晚上 誰都不准先回家

[Outro - band stops on a held crash, spoken]
「下禮拜打誰？」「不管 先去吃鹹酥雞」

tracks.title: 那個高音我練了半年
tracks.mood: six months of practice, and a crack she finished for him
tracks.subject: practising one high note in a parked car for six months to sing it at a girlfriend's birthday
tracks.caption: Taiwanese rock power ballad in the KTV high-belt tradition of Power Station. Opens on a clean chorus-washed electric guitar arpeggio and piano; a distorted rhythm guitar enters at the chorus; a melodic electric guitar solo with long sustained bends; live drums with big reverbed tom fills and ride cymbal through the chorus; sustained root-note bass under a string pad. Roomy and warm, the lead voice and the solo guitar forward. A raspy male tenor in a chest-voice belt, holding long high vowels at the peak; a bright female voice joins on the final chorus and the two harmonise in thirds. 72 BPM, A major, with the final chorus modulating up a whole step to B major. Six months of practising one note for one person, and laughing when it breaks. No electronic beat, no autotune, no breathy whispered delivery, no rap, no soft piano-only ballad arrangement.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short, four bars of clean chorus-washed guitar arpeggio and piano]

[Verse 1]
下班以後 我把車停在地下三樓
車窗搖到最上面 冷氣開到最小
手機放那首歌 前奏一下我就緊張
副歌那個高音 我破了整整半年

[Pre-Chorus]
隔壁車位的大哥 有一次來敲我的窗
他說 少年仔 吸氣要吸到肚子

[Chorus]
這一個高音 是要唱給妳的
妳說這首歌 沒有男生唱得上去
我在地下三樓 跟它吵了半年
妳生日那天 我要整句唱完

[Verse 2]
生日那天 包廂裡 妳的同事都在
輪到我的時候 麥克風好像有十公斤
前面都很穩 到副歌最後那一句
我還是破了 破到服務生都探頭進來

[Chorus]
這一個高音 是要唱給妳的
我破音的那一秒 妳搶過另一支麥克風
妳把那一句接上去 比我還要高
妳唱完就笑到停不下來 我覺得這樣剛剛好

[Guitar Solo - long sustained bends over the full band]

[Chorus - Duet, key change up a whole step]
這一個高音 還是要唱給妳的
明年妳生日 我再唱一次
地下三樓的大哥說 明年他也要來聽
那一天 我們一人唱一半

[Outro - piano and guitar ring out]
生日快樂

tracks.title: 向左轉是另一邊
tracks.mood: taking drill far too seriously and still getting it wrong
tracks.subject: a freshman squad at August military training that cannot turn left in unison, and the instructor who finally laughs on the last day
tracks.caption: Mandarin idol performance dance-pop in the boy-group choreography style. A punchy 808 kick with a clap-stacked snare, trap hi-hat rolls only in the pre-chorus, a plucky synth bass, bright brass stabs and white-noise risers; a beat switch into an instrumental dance break, and a stripped chorus where the beat drops to kick and brass under the chant. Tight, dry and loud, wide stereo synths, the kick and the unison chant forward. Several young male voices split by line: a rhythmic rap verse, a high tenor pre-chorus, a unison shouted chant on the chorus, and spoken drill commands. 120 BPM, F sharp minor. A freshman squad at military training that cannot turn left in unison. No ballad section, no acoustic guitar, no heavy autotune, no EDM supersaw drop, no rock drums, no half-time trap groove, no mumble rap.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - 808 kick and brass stab, spoken drill commands]
立正 稍息 一 二 一

[Verse 1 - Rap]
八月的操場 太陽曬到鞋底發燙
迷彩服發下來 每一件都大兩號
我們這一排十二個 七個戴眼鏡
教官喊向左轉 三個轉到右邊

[Pre-Chorus - high tenor, hi-hat rolls]
向左 向右 向後 停
教官說 你們是我帶過最慘的一屆

[Chorus - group unison chant, beat drops to kick and brass]
向左轉是另一邊 向左轉是另一邊
他喊一次 我們就錯一次
防曬擦到第三層 臉還是紅的
先把這個向左轉 練到不丟臉

[Verse 2 - Rap]
小胖踢正步 同手同腳 自己都不知道
阿凱站軍姿 站到一半 睡著了
晚上拉歌 隔壁連唱得比我們大聲
我們十二個人 用吼的 吼贏他們

[Dance Break - beat switch, brass stabs and 808 slides]

[Chorus - group unison chant]
向左轉是另一邊 向左轉是另一邊
他喊一次 我們就錯一次
會操那天 主席台前 全部轉對了
教官轉過身去 偷偷笑了

[Outro - beat cuts, spoken]
解散
欸 解散是往哪邊

tracks.title: 你不是十二樓的嗎
tracks.mood: flirty recognition at three in the morning
tracks.subject: recognising the man from the twelfth floor who never says good morning on a warehouse dance floor at 3 a.m.
tracks.caption: Mandarin rave house-pop in the peak-time techno-house style. A four-on-the-floor 909 kick with an offbeat open hi-hat, a rolling sixteenth-note techno bassline, a squelching acid 303 line that opens up through the song, short rave piano stabs and a sidechained pad; a long filter-sweep breakdown where the kick drops out, then slams back in. Dark warehouse room sound, wide and pumping, the kick and the lead vocal forward. Confident female diva voice, breathy and half-spoken in the verses, a chanted one-line hook on the chorus doubled in unison by a second female voice. 126 BPM, G minor. Recognising someone at three in the morning and deciding to enjoy it. No trap hi-hats, no guitar, no ballad piano, no jazz-house Rhodes chords, no autotune, no tropical house plucks.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - 909 kick and rolling bassline, acid line creeping in]

[Verse 1]
凌晨三點 倉庫裡 煙霧機開太大
有人一直踩到我的腳 我轉頭準備罵
那副眼鏡 我每天早上在電梯裡都看到
他每天按十二樓 從來沒跟我說過早

[Pre-Chorus]
燈閃了一下 他也認出我了
他假裝不認識我 好 那我也裝

你不是十二樓的嗎
平常領帶打到最上面 現在跳得比我還瘋
你不是十二樓的嗎
星期一電梯門一開 看你還裝不裝

[Verse 2]
他靠過來 在我耳邊用喊的自我介紹
他說他叫阿哲 在做稽核
我說我知道 你每天都買同一杯美式

下一首 你還要不要跳

你不是十二樓的嗎

星期一電梯門一開 早安 這次換你先說

[Outro - acid line and kick, fading]
十二樓 我記住了

tracks.title: 手滑按到讚
tracks.mood: giddy sugar-high crush
tracks.subject: accidentally liking a crush's four-year-old photo at two in the morning
tracks.caption: Y2K bubblegum dance-pop in the early-2000s Taiwanese teen-idol style. A bright square-wave synth lead playing the hook, a glockenspiel doubling the vocal melody, handclaps on every backbeat, a bouncy four-on-the-floor pop beat and palm-muted clean electric guitar; a cheerleader gang chant shouting hey in answer, and a key change up a whole step to E major for the last chorus. Bright, tight and candy-coloured, the glockenspiel and the lead vocal forward. Sweet, light female head voice with cute spoken asides and group hey chants. 130 BPM, D major. A giddy two a.m. crush and one slipped thumb. No dark minor chords, no trap drums, no heavy bass drop, no 80s synthpop gated drums, no autotune, no breathy R&B runs.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - square-wave lead hook, glockenspiel and handclaps]

[Verse 1]
凌晨兩點 棉被裡 手機亮度調到最暗
我在看他的照片 只是看看而已
往下滑 往下滑 滑到四年前
他在海邊 頭髮還是黃的

[Pre-Chorus]
大拇指一抖 一顆愛心跳出來
四年前的照片 被我按了讚

[Chorus]
手滑了 手滑了 (Hey!)
四年前的海邊 有一顆我的愛心
現在收回來 他會不會看到
我把手機丟到床底下 (Hey! Hey!)

[Verse 2]
室友被我吵醒 她說 妳完了
我說 他在睡覺 他一定沒看到
兩點零四分 床底下震了一下
他也按了 我三年前的那張

[Bridge - cheerleader chant and handclaps]
他按回來了 他按回來了 他真的按回來了

[Chorus - key change up, full chant]
手滑了 手滑了 (Hey!)
三年前的我 多了一顆他的愛心
他傳來一句 妳也還沒睡喔
我在棉被裡 尖叫到沒聲音 (Hey! Hey!)

[Outro - glockenspiel alone, spoken]
欸 他是不是也手滑

tracks.title: 請簡短描述您的問題
tracks.mood: fifty-two minutes of polite fury
tracks.subject: fifty-two minutes pressing zero on a telecom hotline's voice bot to reach a human
tracks.caption: Mandarin post-punk in the cold Beijing underground style. A melodic bass played high on the neck carrying the main riff, tight dry drums in motorik eighth notes with floor-tom accents, scratchy flanged guitar stabs, a cold synth drone underneath, and a saxophone that squalls at the climaxes. Spacious and cold, the bass and the voice forward, the vocal in a long dark reverb. Deadpan low male voice, declamatory and half-spoken, flat and patient, rising to hoarse shouts at the end of each chorus. 138 BPM, B minor. Fifty-two minutes of polite fury at a machine. No pop chorus melody, no trap drums, no autotune, no fast hardcore tempo, no warm major-key resolution.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - high melodic bass riff over motorik drums]

[Verse 1]
我家的網路斷了三天 我打給客服
一個很溫柔的聲音說 您好
請簡短描述您的問題
我說 網路斷了
她說 不好意思 我沒有聽懂
您是要申辦新的門號嗎

[Chorus]
請簡短描述您的問題
我的問題 就是你
我按零 我按零 我按了十四次零
真人客服 到底在哪裡

[Verse 2]
第三十一分鐘 她開始放音樂
同一段鋼琴 我現在已經會哼了
第四十分鐘 我對著手機大喊 真人
她說 好的 為您轉接 然後就掛了

[Bridge - saxophone squall, shouted]
網路 斷了
網路 斷了

[Chorus]
請簡短描述您的問題
我的問題 還是你
我按零 我按零 我按了二十二次零
第五十二分鐘 有一個人說 喂

[Outro - bass riff alone, deadpan]
她說 先生 您的網路剛剛已經恢復了
我說 謝謝 我竟然還說了謝謝

[Song ends abruptly]

tracks.title: 收割機又來了
tracks.mood: a flirtation that comes back with the harvest
tracks.subject: the combine-harvester driver who comes through the village every June and the woman who brings him tea
tracks.caption: Northwest Chinese hua'er highland pop, a modern Hezhou-style folk song with a band. Opens with a free-time a cappella male call, then an acoustic guitar drone, a banhu answering each vocal phrase, a deep frame drum and hand drums in a loping four-four, a fingered bass and a sparse synth pad. Open and airy with an outdoor feel, the two voices and the banhu forward, the drums low and round. A male and a female voice singing a call-and-response duet in a high piercing head voice, with falsetto flips on long held vowels and ai-hai-yo vocables. Free-time intro, then 88 BPM, D major with a pentatonic melody. A harvest-season flirtation that comes back once a year. No guzheng, no guofeng orchestra, no Mongolian morin khuur, no Yunnan-style southwest folk-pop, no rock drum kit, no piano ballad, no trap drums, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - free-time a cappella male call, high falsetto]
哎 麥子黃了 收割機上山了喲

[Verse 1 - Male]
我開著收割機 從河州一路割上來
一年就來這一回 六月的日頭曬脫了皮
溝口數過來 第三塊是你家的地
地埂上的尕妹妹 提著一壺茶

[Verse 2 - Female]
阿哥你的機器聲 半個村子都聽見
我說是給你送茶 其實茶早就涼了
去年你說明年還來 我數了三百多天
今年你的帽子 怎麼換成紅的了

[Chorus - male calls, female answers, band enters]
收割機又來了 哎嗨喲
麥子一年黃一回 你一年來一回

tracks.title: 他們唱得比我們好
tracks.mood: jealous and proud at once
tracks.subject: watching a student band cover the song you wrote at nineteen, better than your band ever played it
tracks.caption: Brass-and-strings emo revival in the Chinese Midwest-emo style. Twinkly clean electric guitar arpeggios in open tuning, driving straight four-four drums with crash-ride build-ups, a trumpet playing countermelodies between the vocal lines, a string section swelling under the choruses, and a slow crescendo into a wall of distorted guitars at the bridge. Live room sound, slightly raw, the guitars and the trumpet forward. Strained, cracking male tenor sung confessionally, with gang shouts on the chorus and a screamed outburst at the climax. 140 BPM, C major. Jealous and proud at once. No odd time signatures, no finger tapping, no pop-punk palm-muted chugging, no polished pop production, no autotune, no electronic drums.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - twinkly open-tuned clean guitar and a lone trumpet]

[Verse 1]
星期四的livehouse 我本來只是來喝一杯
台上四個大學生 鼓手還穿著系服
第三首 吉他一刷下去 我的啤酒停在嘴邊
那是我十九歲 在宿舍上鋪寫的歌

[Pre-Chorus]
我們只錄過一次 用一支手機
上傳以後 總共三十七個人聽過

[Chorus]
他們唱得比我們好
小號吹的那一段 是我當年想不出來的
台下有人 每一個字都跟著唱
我站在最後面 不知道要不要拍手

[Verse 2]
我們的貝斯手 現在在賣保險
鼓手搬去別的城市 過年才回來一次
我在群組打 你們一定不會相信
已讀三個 沒人回 然後三個人同時打來

[Chorus - gang shouts]
他們唱得比我們好
小號吹的那一段 是我當年想不出來的
最後一句 全場一起喊
那一句是我寫的 我也跟著喊了

[Bridge - strings swell into a wall of distortion, screamed]
那是我寫的 那是我們的
我們唱得很爛 可是是我們先唱的

[Outro - clean guitar alone]
散場的時候 主唱問我 大哥你也喜歡這首喔
我說 嗯 很喜歡

tracks.title: 陽傘往左移一點
tracks.mood: a lazy afternoon off, in love
tracks.subject: moving the balcony parasol every twenty minutes on an afternoon off so the sun stays off a sleeping partner's face
tracks.caption: Mandarin bossa nova breeze pop. Nylon-string guitar in bossa comping with the thumb on beats one and three and syncopated chord pushes, cross-stick rim clicks and brushes, a shaker, a round mellow bass, and a flute answering the vocal lines, with a soft synth pad underneath. Close, dry and intimate, narrow, the guitar and the voice forward. Soft close-miked female voice, almost whispered, unhurried and sitting slightly behind the beat. 124 BPM, F major. A lazy afternoon off with someone you live with and like. No piano trio swing, no city-pop gloss, no electric guitar, no programmed drums, no lo-fi hip-hop beat, no belting, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - nylon-string bossa comping and brushes]

[Verse 1]
放假的下午兩點 你說只躺五分鐘
陽台的折疊椅 你的腳伸到我這邊
小說蓋在你臉上 停在第十二頁
太陽慢慢爬過來 爬到你的耳朵

[Pre-Chorus]
我站起來 把陽傘往左移一點
你翻個身 說了一句我聽不懂的話

[Chorus]
陽傘往左移一點 影子剛好蓋住你
每二十分鐘 我就起來一次
冰咖啡的冰塊 一顆一顆化掉
我沒有叫醒你 我也哪裡都不想去

[Verse 2]
樓下有人在修機車 收音機開得很小聲
隔壁的貓走過欄杆 看了你一眼
四點半 太陽繞到晾衣架後面
陽傘跟著它 已經轉了快半圈

[Chorus]
陽傘往左移一點 影子剛好蓋住你
每二十分鐘 我就起來一次
你醒來第一句 問我現在幾點
我說 還早 其實天都快黑了

[Outro - flute answering, fading]
下次放假
換你幫我撐

樓下有人在修機車 收音機開得很小聲
隔壁的貓走過欄杆 看了你一眼
四點半 太陽繞到晾衣架後面
陽傘跟著它 已經轉了快半圈
[Chorus]
陽傘往左移一點 影子剛好蓋住你
每二十分鐘 我就起來一次
你醒來第一句 問我現在幾點
我說 還早 其實天都快黑了
[Outro - flute answering, fading]
下次放假
換你幫我撐

tracks.title: 對面阿姨在跳舞
tracks.mood: nosy, whimsical delight
tracks.subject: the woman across the courtyard who waltzes with her mop at nine every night
tracks.caption: Mandarin fairy-tale chamber-pop waltz in three-four time. A celesta playing a music-box melody, a fingerpicked acoustic guitar, a harpsichord, a pizzicato string quartet, and a clarinet answering the voice, over an oom-pah-pah waltz bass from a pizzicato double bass on beat one, with a lightly brushed snare. Small and close like a room, intimate and narrow, the celesta and the voice forward. Intimate close-miked female storyteller voice with light vibrato and a whispered spoken aside. 138 BPM, B flat major. Watching a stranger's happiness from a window and joining in. No four-four beat, no big orchestral string swells, no full drum kit, no synth, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - celesta music-box melody and pizzicato strings in three]

[Verse 1]
晚上九點 對面四樓的燈準時亮起來
那個阿姨 穿著紅色的拖鞋
她拿起拖把 好像在牽一個人的手
一 二 三 一 二 三 在客廳轉圈

[Pre-Chorus]
我的泡麵泡到一半 就站到窗戶旁邊
我發誓 我沒有在偷看

[Chorus]
對面那個阿姨在跳舞
地板擦得發亮 音樂我聽不到
她轉到窗邊 拖把也跟著彎腰
我在這邊 也偷偷轉了一圈

[Verse 2]
有一個禮拜 九點了 燈都沒有亮
我開始擔心 是拖把壞了 還是她生病了
星期天晚上 那盞燈終於亮了
她牽著的 是一個穿西裝的阿伯

[Chorus]
對面那個阿姨在跳舞
地板擦得發亮 音樂我聽不到
拖把靠在牆角 好像也在看
我在這邊 輕輕拍了三下手

[Outro - music box winding down, whispered]
拖把 你也辛苦了
